title.raw: 卷三十八 志第十九: 禮十一 外國使入見儀 曲宴儀 朝辭儀 新定夏使儀注 Volume 38 Treatises 19: Rites 11 - Ceremonies for Receiving Foreign Emissaries; Music for Banquets; Farewell Rituals; Ceremonies for Newly Appointed Officials

sentences.zh: 外國使入見儀

translations.literal: Ceremonies for foreign emissaries' audiences
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonies for Foreign Emissaries' Audiences

sentences.zh: 皇帝即御座，鳴鞭、報時畢，殿前班小起居，引至侍立位。

translations.literal: The emperor took the imperial seat; when the whip was sounded and the time announced, the front hall formation performed the minor bow of respect and was led to their standing-attendance positions.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor had taken the throne, the time was announced and the whip sounded. The front-hall formation made the minor bow of respect and was escorted to their standing-attendance posts.

sentences.zh: 引臣僚左右入，至丹墀，小起居畢，宰執上殿，其餘臣僚分班出。

translations.literal: Officials were led in from left and right to the red terrace; when the minor bow was finished, the chief ministers ascended the hall and the remaining officials filed out by formation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were led in from both sides to the court terrace. After the minor bow, the chief ministers went up to the hall while the rest of the officials filed out by formation.

sentences.zh: 閣門使奏使者入見榜子。

translations.literal: The Gate Office commissioner reported the notice board for the emissaries' audience.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office commissioner announced the notice of the emissaries' audience.

sentences.zh: 先引宋使、副，出笏，捧書左入，至丹墀北向立。

translations.literal: First the Song envoy and deputy were led in; they produced their tablets, bore the letter in from the left, and stood facing north on the red terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoy and deputy were led in first. They produced their court tablets, entered from the left bearing the letter, and stood facing north on the court terrace.

sentences.zh: 閣使左下接書，捧書者單跪授書，拜，起立。

translations.literal: The Gate commissioner came down on the left to receive the letter; the bearer knelt on one knee to present it, bowed, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate commissioner descended on the left to receive the letter. The bearer knelt on one knee to hand it over, bowed, and stood up again.

sentences.zh: 閣使左上露階，右入欄內奏：「封全。

translations.literal: The Gate commissioner ascended the open steps on the left, entered the railing on the right, and reported: "The seal is intact.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate commissioner went up the open steps on the left, entered the railing on the right, and reported: "The seal is intact.

sentences.zh: 」轉讀畢，引使、副左上露階，齊揖入欄內，揖使副鞠躬，使少前拜跪，附奏畢，拜起，復位立。

translations.literal: " When the reading was finished, the envoy and deputy were led up the open steps on the left; they bowed together and entered the railing; the envoy and deputy were prompted to bow; the envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed, presented the attached memorial, finished, bowed and rose, and returned to stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: " After the letter had been read aloud, the envoy and deputy were led up the open steps on the left. They bowed together and entered the railing. The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow; the envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed, presented the attached memorial, then rose and returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 待宣問宋皇帝時並鞠躬，受敕旨，再揖鞠躬，使少前拜跪，奏畢，起復位，齊退卻，引使、副左下，至丹墀北向立。

translations.literal: When the imperial inquiry concerning the Song emperor was announced, all bowed; they received the edict instruction; again they were prompted to bow; the envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed, finished the report, rose and returned to place; all withdrew together; the envoy and deputy were led down on the left to stand facing north on the red terrace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor's inquiry about the Song emperor was announced, all bowed and received the edict. They were prompted to bow again; the envoy stepped forward, knelt and bowed, and finished his report. Then they all withdrew together, and the envoy and deputy were led down on the left to stand facing north on the court terrace.

sentences.zh: 禮物右入左出，盡，揖使、副傍折通班，再引至丹墀，舞蹈，五拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: Tribute gifts entered from the right and exited from the left until finished; the envoy and deputy were prompted to turn aside through the formation; they were led again to the red terrace, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute gifts were brought in from the right and taken out on the left until all had been presented. The envoy and deputy were led through the formation and back to the court terrace, where they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations. Without leaving formation they reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」再拜。

translations.literal: " They bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again.

sentences.zh: 揖使副鞠躬，使出班謝面天顏，復位，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow; the envoy left formation to thank the emperor for beholding his countenance, returned to place, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow. The envoy stepped out of formation to thank the emperor for granting him an audience, returned to his place, and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 再揖副使鞠躬，使出班謝遠差接伴、兼賜湯藥諸物等，復位，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: Again the deputy was prompted to bow; the envoy left formation to thank the long-distance escort and reception, as well as the gift of medicinal broth and other items, returned to place, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy was prompted to bow again. The envoy stepped out of formation to thank the court for the long-distance escort and reception and for the medicinal broth and other gifts, then returned to his place and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 各祗候，引右出，賜衣。

translations.literal: Each attended in place; they were led out on the right and granted robes.
translations.idiomatic: Each remained in attendance. They were led out on the right and granted robes of honor.

sentences.zh: 次引宋人從入，通名已下再拜不出班，又再拜，各祗候，亦引右出。

translations.literal: Next the Song attendants were led in; from the announcement of names downward they bowed again without leaving formation, bowed again, each attended in place, and were also led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Song attendants were led in. From the announcement of names onward they bowed again without leaving formation, then bowed once more. Each remained in attendance before being led out on the right as well.

sentences.zh: 次引高麗使左入，至丹墀北向略立，引使左上露階，立定。

translations.literal: Next the Goryeo envoy was led in from the left, came briefly to stand facing north on the red terrace, and was led up the open steps on the left to stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Goryeo envoy was led in from the left, paused briefly facing north on the court terrace, and was escorted up the open steps on the left to take his place.

sentences.zh: 揖橫使鞠躬，正使少前拜跪，附奏畢，拜起，復位立，閣使宣問高麗王時並鞠躬，受敕旨畢，再揖橫使鞠躬，正使少前拜跪，奏畢，拜起，復位，齊退卻，引左下，至丹墀，面殿立定。

translations.literal: The lateral envoys were prompted to bow; the chief envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed, finished the attached memorial, bowed and rose and returned to stand; when the Gate commissioner announced the inquiry concerning the king of Goryeo, all bowed; when the edict instruction was received, again the lateral envoys were prompted to bow; the chief envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed, finished the report, bowed and rose and returned to place; all withdrew together; they were led down on the left to the red terrace and stood facing the hall in place.
translations.idiomatic: The lateral envoys were prompted to bow. The chief envoy stepped forward, knelt and bowed, and presented the attached memorial before rising and returning to his place. When the Gate commissioner announced the inquiry about the king of Goryeo, all bowed and received the edict. The lateral envoys were prompted to bow again; the chief envoy stepped forward, knelt and bowed, and finished his report before rising. They all withdrew together, were led down on the left to the court terrace, and stood facing the hall.

sentences.zh: 禮物右入左出，盡，揖使傍折通班，畢，引至丹墀，通一十七拜，各祗候，平立，引左階立。

translations.literal: Tribute gifts entered from the right and exited from the left until finished; the envoy was prompted to turn aside through the formation; when finished, he was led to the red terrace and performed seventeen prostrations in all; each attended in place and stood level; he was led to stand on the left steps.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute gifts were brought in from the right and taken out on the left until all had been presented. The envoy was led through the formation and back to the court terrace, where he performed seventeen prostrations in all. Each remained in attendance standing at ease before being posted on the left steps.

sentences.zh: 次引夏使見如上儀，引右階立。

translations.literal: Next the Xi Xia envoy was led in for an audience by the same protocol and posted to stand on the right steps.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Western Xia envoy was received according to the same protocol and posted on the right steps.

sentences.zh: 次再引宋使副左入，至丹墀，謝恩，舞蹈，五拜，各祗候，平立。

translations.literal: Next the Song envoy and deputy were again led in from the left to the red terrace to thank the grace received; they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations; each attended in place and stood level.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoy and deputy were then led in again from the left to the court terrace to offer thanks for imperial favor. They performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, remained in attendance, and stood at ease.

sentences.zh: 次引高麗、夏使並至丹墀。

translations.literal: Next the Goryeo and Xi Xia envoys were led together to the red terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Goryeo and Western Xia envoys were led together to the court terrace.

sentences.zh: 三使並鞠躬，有敕賜酒食，舞蹈，五拜，各祗候，引右出。

translations.literal: All three envoys bowed together; an edict granted wine and food; they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations; each attended in place; they were led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: All three envoys bowed together. When an edict granted wine and food, they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, remained in attendance, and were led out on the right.

sentences.zh: 次引宰執下殿，禮畢。

translations.literal: Next the chief ministers were led down from the hall and the ceremony was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were then led down from the hall, and the ceremony was complete.

sentences.zh: 曲宴儀

translations.literal: Banquet ceremony
translations.idiomatic: Banquet Ceremonies

sentences.zh: 皇帝即御座，鳴鞭，報時畢，殿前班小起居，到侍立位。

translations.literal: The emperor took the imperial seat; the whip was sounded and the time announced; the front hall formation performed the minor bow of respect and reached their standing-attendance positions.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor had taken the throne, the time was announced and the whip sounded. The front-hall formation made the minor bow of respect and took up their standing-attendance posts.

sentences.zh: 引臣僚並使客左入，傍折通班，至丹墀舞蹈，五拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: Officials and envoy-guests were led in from the left, turned aside through the formation, came to the red terrace, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and the envoy-guests were led in from the left, passed through the formation, and came to the court terrace, where they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations. Without leaving formation they reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: " They bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again.

sentences.zh: 出班謝宴，舞蹈，五拜，各上殿祗候。

translations.literal: They left formation to thank the banquet, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and each ascended the hall to attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: They stepped out of formation to thank the court for the banquet, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and each went up to the hall to take up attendance.

sentences.zh: 分引預宴官上殿，其餘臣僚右出。

translations.literal: Those scheduled for the banquet were led separately up to the hall; the remaining officials exited on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Those officials scheduled to attend the banquet were led up to the hall in turn, while the rest of the officials exited on the right.

sentences.zh: 次引宋使從人入，至丹墀再拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: Next the Song attendants were led in; they came to the red terrace and bowed again, and without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Song attendants were led in. They came to the court terrace and bowed again, then reported without leaving formation: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: " They bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again.

sentences.zh: 有敕賜酒食，又再拜，引左廊立。

translations.literal: An edict granted wine and food; they bowed again and were led to stand in the left corridor.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict granted wine and food, they bowed again and were posted to stand in the left corridor.

sentences.zh: 次引高麗、夏從人入，分引左右廊立。

translations.literal: Next the Goryeo and Xi Xia attendants were led in and posted separately to stand in the left and right corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Goryeo and Western Xia attendants were led in and posted to stand in the left and right corridors respectively.

sentences.zh: 果床入，進酒。

translations.literal: The fruit table entered and wine was presented.
translations.idiomatic: The fruit table was brought in and wine was served.

sentences.zh: 皇帝舉酒時，上下侍立官並再拜，接盞，畢，候進酒官到位，當坐者再拜，坐，即行臣使酒。

translations.literal: When the emperor raised his cup, all standing officials above and below bowed again, received the cup, and when finished waited until the wine-presenting officer was in place; those who were to sit bowed again and sat, and then wine was served to the envoy-officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor raised his cup, all standing officials above and below bowed again and received their cups. After this was done, they waited until the wine-presenting officer was in place. Those who were to be seated bowed again and sat down, and wine was then served to the envoys and officials.

sentences.zh: 傳宣，立飲畢，再拜，坐。

translations.literal: The announcement was transmitted; they stood, finished drinking, bowed again, and sat.
translations.idiomatic: At the transmitted command they stood, finished drinking, bowed again, and sat down.

sentences.zh: 次從人再拜，坐。

translations.literal: Next the attendants bowed again and sat.
translations.idiomatic: The attendants then bowed again and sat down.

sentences.zh: 至四盞，餅茶入，致語。

translations.literal: At the fourth round, cakes and tea entered and congratulatory words were delivered.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth round of wine, cakes and tea were brought in and congratulatory words were delivered.

sentences.zh: 聞鼓笛時，揖臣使並人從立，口號絕，坐宴並侍立官並再拜，坐，次從人再拜，坐。

translations.literal: When drums and flutes were heard, the envoy-officials and attendants were prompted to rise; when the shouted refrain ended, those seated at the banquet and the standing officials all bowed again and sat; next the attendants bowed again and sat.
translations.idiomatic: When drums and flutes sounded, the envoys and attendants were prompted to rise. When the shouted refrain ended, those seated at the banquet and the standing officials all bowed again and sat down, and then the attendants bowed again and sat as well.

sentences.zh: 食入，五盞，歇宴。

translations.literal: Food entered; at the fifth round the banquet paused.
translations.idiomatic: Food was served. At the fifth round the banquet paused.

sentences.zh: 教坊謝恩畢，揖臣使起，果床出。

translations.literal: When the Directorate of Music had finished thanking for grace, the envoy-officials were prompted to rise and the fruit table withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After the Directorate of Music had finished offering thanks, the envoys were prompted to rise and the fruit table was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 皇帝起入閣，臣使下殿歸幕次。

translations.literal: The emperor rose and entered the side chamber; the envoy-officials descended from the hall and returned to their tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rose and withdrew to the side chamber. The envoys left the hall and returned to their lodging quarters.

sentences.zh: 賜花，人從隨出戴花畢，先引人從入，左右廊立，次引臣使入，左右上殿位立。

translations.literal: Flowers were granted; the attendants went out with them and finished putting on the flowers; the attendants were led in first to stand in the left and right corridors; next the envoy-officials were led in to stand in their left and right positions on the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Flowers were granted. The attendants went out to put them on, and once they had done so the attendants were led in first to stand in the left and right corridors. The envoys were then led in to take their standing positions on the left and right sides of the hall.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出閣坐，果床入，坐立並再拜，坐，次從人再拜，坐。

translations.literal: The emperor came out of the side chamber and sat; the fruit table entered; those standing and sitting all bowed again and sat; next the attendants bowed again and sat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came out of the side chamber and took his seat. The fruit table was brought in. Those standing and those seated all bowed again and sat down, and then the attendants bowed again and sat as well.

sentences.zh: 九盞，將曲終，揖從人至位再拜，引出。

translations.literal: At the ninth round, as the music was about to end, the attendants were prompted to their places, bowed again, and were led out.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth round, as the music was nearing its end, the attendants were prompted to their places, bowed again, and were led out.

sentences.zh: 聞曲時，揖臣使起，再拜，下殿。

translations.literal: When the music was heard, the envoy-officials were prompted to rise, bowed again, and descended from the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the music sounded, the envoys were prompted to rise, bowed again, and left the hall.

sentences.zh: 果床出。

translations.literal: The fruit table withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The fruit table was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 至丹墀謝宴，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: They came to the red terrace to thank the banquet, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: They came to the court terrace to thank the court for the banquet and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 分引出。

translations.literal: They were led out separately.
translations.idiomatic: They were led out in separate groups.

sentences.zh: 朝辭儀

translations.literal: Farewell audience ceremonies
translations.idiomatic: Farewell Audience Ceremonies

sentences.zh: 皇帝即御座，鳴鞭、報時畢，殿前班小起居，至侍立位。

translations.literal: The emperor took the imperial seat; when the whip was sounded and the time announced, the front hall formation performed the minor bow of respect and reached their standing-attendance positions.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor had taken the throne, the time was announced and the whip sounded. The front-hall formation made the minor bow of respect and took up their standing-attendance posts.

sentences.zh: 引臣僚合班入，至丹墀小起居，引宰執上殿，其餘臣僚分班出。

translations.literal: Officials were led in as a combined formation to the red terrace for the minor bow of respect; the chief ministers were led up to the hall and the remaining officials filed out by formation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were led in as a combined formation to the court terrace for the minor bow of respect. The chief ministers were escorted up to the hall while the remaining officials filed out by formation.

sentences.zh: 閣門使奏辭榜子。

translations.literal: The Gate Office commissioner reported the farewell notice board.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office commissioner announced the farewell notice.

sentences.zh: 先引夏使左入，傍折通班畢，至丹墀再拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: First the Xi Xia envoy was led in from the left; when he had turned aside through the formation, he came to the red terrace and bowed again, and without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia envoy was led in first from the left. After passing through the formation, he came to the court terrace and bowed again, then reported without leaving formation: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: " He bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed again.

sentences.zh: 揖使副鞠躬，使出班，戀闕致詞，復位，又再拜，唱：「各好去。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow; the envoy left formation and delivered the parting words of lingering regard for the court, returned to place, bowed again, and the herald called: "Each of you, go in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow. The envoy stepped out of formation to deliver the parting words expressing reluctance to leave the court, returned to his place, and bowed again. The herald called out: "Each of you, go in peace.

sentences.zh: 」引右出。

translations.literal: " He was led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: " He was led out on the right.

sentences.zh: 次引高麗使，如上儀，亦引右出。

translations.literal: Next the Goryeo envoy was led in by the same protocol and was also led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Goryeo envoy was received according to the same protocol and was also led out on the right.

sentences.zh: 次引宋使副左入，傍折通班畢，至丹墀，依上通六拜，各祗候，平立。

translations.literal: Next the Song envoy and deputy were led in from the left; when they had turned aside through the formation, they came to the red terrace and, following the above, performed six prostrations in all; each attended in place and stood level.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Song envoy and deputy were led in from the left. After passing through the formation, they came to the court terrace and performed six prostrations in all as prescribed above. Each remained in attendance standing at ease.

sentences.zh: 閣使賜衣馬，鞠躬，聞敕，再拜。

translations.literal: The Gate commissioner granted robes and horses; they bowed, heard the edict, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate commissioner granted robes and horses. They bowed, heard the edict, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 賜衣馬畢，平身，搢笏，單跪，受別錄物過盡，出笏，拜起，謝恩，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: When the granting of robes and horses was finished, they stood level, tucked in their tablets, knelt on one knee, received the separate recorded items until all had passed, produced their tablets, bowed and rose, thanked for grace, and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: When the robes and horses had been granted, they stood upright, tucked in their court tablets, and knelt on one knee to receive the separate recorded items until all had been presented. They then produced their tablets, bowed and rose, offered thanks for imperial favor, and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 有敕賜酒食，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: An edict granted wine and food; they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict granted wine and food, they performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 引使副左上露階，齊揖入欄內，揖鞠躬，大使少前拜跪受書，起復位。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were led up the open steps on the left; they bowed together and entered the railing; they were prompted to bow; the chief envoy stepped slightly forward, knelt and bowed to receive the letter, rose and returned to place.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were led up the open steps on the left. They bowed together and entered the railing. The chief envoy was prompted to bow, stepped forward, knelt and bowed to receive the letter, then rose and returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 揖使副齊鞠躬，受傳達畢，齊退，引左下至丹墀，鞠躬，喝：「各好去。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow together; when the transmitted message had been received, all withdrew together; they were led down on the left to the red terrace, bowed, and the herald called: "Each of you, go in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were prompted to bow together. When the transmitted message had been received, they all withdrew. They were led down on the left to the court terrace, bowed, and the herald called out: "Each of you, go in peace.

sentences.zh: 」引右出。

translations.literal: " They were led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: " They were led out on the right.

sentences.zh: 次引宰執下殿，禮畢。

translations.literal: Next the chief ministers were led down from the hall and the ceremony was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were then led down from the hall, and the ceremony was complete.

sentences.zh: 熙宗時，夏使入見，改為大起居。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xizong, when the Xi Xia envoy had an audience, it was changed to the major bow of respect.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Emperor Xizong, the Western Xia envoy's audience was changed to use the major bow of respect.

sentences.zh: 定制以宋使列于三品班，高麗、夏列于五品班。

translations.literal: It was fixed by regulation that the Song envoy was ranked in the third-rank formation, and Goryeo and Xi Xia in the fifth-rank formation.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations fixed the Song envoy in the third-rank formation and the Goryeo and Western Xia envoys in the fifth-rank formation.

sentences.zh: 皇統二年六月，定臣使辭見，臣僚服色拜數止從常朝起居，三國使班品如舊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Huangtong, it was fixed that for envoy-officials' farewell audiences, officials' dress colors and number of bows followed only the regular court minor bow of respect, while the three states' envoys' formation ranks remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Huangtong, regulations fixed that for envoys' farewell audiences, officials' dress colors and number of bows followed only the regular court bow of respect, while the three states' envoys kept their former formation ranks.

sentences.zh: 俟殿前班及臣僚小起居畢，宰執升殿，余臣分班畢，乃令行入見及朝辭之禮。

translations.literal: Only after the front hall formation and the officials' minor bow of respect were finished, the chief ministers ascended the hall, and the remaining officials had finished filing by formation, were the audience and farewell ceremonies ordered to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Only after the front-hall formation and the officials' minor bow of respect were finished, the chief ministers had ascended the hall, and the remaining officials had taken their formations was the court ordered to proceed with the audience and farewell ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 凡入見則宋使先，禮畢夏使入，禮畢而高麗使入。

translations.literal: In general, at audiences the Song envoy came first; when his ceremony was finished the Xi Xia envoy entered; when that ceremony was finished the Goryeo envoy entered.
translations.idiomatic: At audiences the Song envoy always came first. When his ceremony was finished, the Western Xia envoy entered, and when that was finished, the Goryeo envoy entered.

sentences.zh: 其朝辭則夏使先，禮畢而高麗使入，禮畢而宋使入。

translations.literal: At farewell audiences the Xi Xia envoy came first; when his ceremony was finished the Goryeo envoy entered; when that ceremony was finished the Song envoy entered.
translations.idiomatic: At farewell audiences the Western Xia envoy came first. When his ceremony was finished, the Goryeo envoy entered, and when that was finished, the Song envoy entered.

sentences.zh: 夏、高麗朝辭之賜，則遣使就賜于會同館。

translations.literal: Grants at the Xi Xia and Goryeo farewell audiences were sent by envoys to bestow at the Hall of Joint Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Grants at the Western Xia and Goryeo farewell audiences were sent by envoys to bestow at the Hall of Joint Harmony.

sentences.zh: 惟宋使之賜則庭授。

translations.literal: Only the Song envoy's grants were conferred in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Song envoy's grants were conferred in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 舊高麗使至闕皆有私進禮，大定五年，上以宋、夏使皆無此禮，而小國獨有之，不可。

translations.literal: Formerly Goryeo envoys upon reaching the capital all had private presentation gifts; in the fifth year of Dading, the emperor said that Song and Xi Xia envoys had no such ceremony while a small state alone had it, which was not permissible.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Goryeo envoys always presented private gifts upon reaching the capital. In the fifth year of Dading, the emperor said that Song and Western Xia envoys had no such practice while a small state alone maintained it, which was unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 遂命罷之。

translations.literal: He then ordered it abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the practice abolished.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔外國使初見、朝辭則于左掖門出入，朝賀，賜宴則由應天門東偏門出入。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict ordered that foreign envoys for their first audience and farewell audience should enter and exit by the Left Flank Gate, while for court congratulations and granted banquets they should enter and exit by the eastern side gate of the Gate of Accepting Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, an edict ordered that foreign envoys should use the Left Flank Gate for their first audience and farewell audience, but the eastern side gate of the Gate of Accepting Heaven for court congratulations and granted banquets.

sentences.zh: 大定二十九年三月，章宗以在諒暗，免宋使朝辭，太常寺言：「若不面授書及傳達語言，恐後別有違失。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading, because Zhangzong was in mourning seclusion, the Song envoy's farewell audience was waived; the Directorate of Ceremonies said: "If the letter is not conferred face to face and the transmitted words are not delivered, there may later be separate oversights.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading, because Emperor Zhangzong was in mourning seclusion, the Song envoy's farewell audience was waived. The Directorate of Ceremonies said: "If the letter is not conferred face to face and the transmitted message is not delivered, there may later be misunderstandings.

sentences.zh: 」遂令宋使先辭靈幄，然後詣仁政殿朝辭，授書。

translations.literal: " The Song envoy was therefore ordered first to take leave at the mourning canopy, then to proceed to the Hall of Benevolent Governance for the farewell audience and receive the letter.
translations.idiomatic: " The Song envoy was therefore ordered first to take leave at the mourning canopy, then to proceed to the Hall of Benevolent Governance for his farewell audience and receive the letter.

sentences.zh: 時右丞相襄言：「伏見熙宗聖誕七月七日，以景宣忌辰避之，更為翌日，複用正月十七日受外國賀。

translations.literal: At that time the Right Chancellor Xiang said: "I observe that Emperor Xizong's sacred birthday was the seventh day of the seventh month, but because of Jingxuan's death anniversary it was avoided and moved to the next day, and again the seventeenth day of the first month was used to receive foreign congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Right Chancellor Xiang said: "I observe that Emperor Xizong's sacred birthday fell on the seventh day of the seventh month, but because of Jingxuan's death anniversary it was moved to the following day, and foreign congratulations were again received on the seventeenth day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 今耶誕節若依期，令外方人使過界，恐為雨潦所滯，設能到闕，或值陰雨亦難行禮，乞以正月十一日或三月十五日為聖節，定宋人過界之期。

translations.literal: If the present sacred birthday is kept to schedule and foreign envoys are made to cross the border, I fear they may be delayed by rain and flooding; even if they can reach the capital, if they meet overcast rain the ceremony will also be hard to perform. I beg that the eleventh day of the first month or the fifteenth day of the third month be made the sacred festival and the date for Song envoys to cross the border be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: If the present sacred birthday is kept on schedule and foreign envoys are required to cross the border, they may be delayed by rain and flooding. Even if they reach the capital, overcast weather would make the ceremony difficult to perform. I beg that the eleventh day of the first month or the fifteenth day of the third month be made the sacred festival and that the date for Song envoys to cross the border be fixed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」平章政事張汝霖、參知政事劉瑋等言：「帝王當示信，以雨潦路阻輒改之，或恐失信。

translations.literal: " The Grand Councilors Zhang Rulin and Liu Wei and others said: "A ruler should display trustworthiness; to change the date merely because rain and flooding block the roads may cause loss of faith.
translations.idiomatic: " The Grand Councilors Zhang Rulin and Liu Wei and others said: "A ruler should display trustworthiness. To change the date merely because rain and flooding block the roads may cause the court to lose credibility.

sentences.zh: 且宋帝生日亦五月也，是時都在會甯，上國遣使賜生日，萬里渡越江、河，尚不避霖潦，如期而至。

translations.literal: Moreover the Song emperor's birthday is also in the fifth month; at that time both courts are at Huining, and our state sends envoys to grant birthday gifts, crossing rivers for ten thousand li yet not avoiding heavy rain and flooding, arriving on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Song emperor's birthday also falls in the fifth month. At that time both courts are at Huining, and our state sends envoys to grant birthday gifts. They cross rivers for thousands of miles without avoiding heavy rain and flooding, and still arrive on schedule.

sentences.zh: 今久與宋好，不可以小阻示以不實。

translations.literal: Now that we have long been on good terms with Song, we cannot show insincerity because of a small obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Now that we have long been on good terms with Song, we cannot show insincerity over a minor obstruction.

sentences.zh: 彼若過界，多作程頓亦不至留滯，縱使雨水愆期而入見，猶勝更用他日也。

translations.literal: If they cross the border, even with many relay stages they need not be detained; even if rain delays their audience past the scheduled day, that is still better than changing to another day.
translations.idiomatic: If they cross the border, even with many relay stages they need not be detained. Even if rain delays their audience past the scheduled day, that is still better than changing to another day.

sentences.zh: 」御史大夫唐括貢、中丞李晏、刑部尚書兼右諫議大夫完顏守貞等亦皆言不可，上初從之，既而竟用襄議，令有司移報，使明知聖誕之實，特改其日以示優待行人之意。

translations.literal: " The Censor-in-Chief Tangut Gong, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yan, Minister of Justice and Right Remonstrance Officer Wanyan Shouzhen and others also all said it could not be done; the emperor at first followed them, but in the end adopted Xiang's proposal, ordering the responsible offices to send notice abroad so that the envoys would clearly know the true sacred birthday and that the day was specially changed to show favor toward traveling envoys.
translations.idiomatic: " The Censor-in-Chief Tangut Gong, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yan, Minister of Justice and Right Remonstrance Officer Wanyan Shouzhen, and others also all opposed the change. The emperor at first followed them, but in the end adopted Xiang's proposal and ordered the responsible offices to notify the foreign court so that the envoys would know the true sacred birthday and understand that the day had been specially changed to show favor toward traveling envoys.

sentences.zh: 承安三年正月，上諭旨有司曰：「此聞宋國花宴，殿上不設肴饌，至其歇時乃備於廊下。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Cheng'an, the emperor instructed the responsible offices: "I have heard that at Song's flower banquet no dishes are set on the hall floor, and food is prepared only in the corridors when the pause comes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Cheng'an, the emperor instructed the responsible offices: "I have heard that at the Song flower banquet no dishes are set out in the hall, and food is prepared only in the corridors during the pause.

sentences.zh: 今花宴上賜食甚為拘束，若依彼例可乎？

translations.literal: At our present flower banquet the granted food is very constrained; would it be acceptable to follow their example?
translations.idiomatic: At our present flower banquet the granted food is very constrained. Would it be acceptable to follow their example?

sentences.zh: 且向者人使見辭，殿上亦嘗有酒禮，今已移在館宴矣」。

translations.literal: Moreover, formerly at envoys' audiences and farewells there was also a wine ceremony on the hall floor, but now it has been moved to banquets at the hostel."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, formerly at envoys' audiences and farewells there was also a wine ceremony in the hall, but that has now been moved to banquets at the hostel."

sentences.zh: 有司奏曰：「曲宴之禮舊矣。

translations.literal: The responsible offices reported: "The banquet ceremony is long established.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices reported: "The banquet ceremony is long established.

sentences.zh: 彼方，酒一行、食一上必相須成禮。

translations.literal: In their state, each round of wine and each serving of food must follow one another to complete the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In their state, each round of wine and each serving of food must follow one another to complete the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 而國朝之例，酒既罷而食始進。

translations.literal: But in our dynasty's precedent, when wine is finished food is only then brought in.
translations.idiomatic: But in our dynasty's precedent, food is brought in only after the wine rounds are finished.

sentences.zh: 至於花宴日，宋使至客省幕次有酒禮，而我使至其幕則有食而無酒，各因其舊，不必相同。

translations.literal: As for the flower banquet day, when the Song envoy comes to the Guest Reception Office tent quarters there is a wine ceremony, while when our envoy comes to their tent there is food but no wine; each follows its own old practice and need not be the same.
translations.idiomatic: On the flower banquet day, when the Song envoy comes to the Guest Reception Office quarters there is a wine ceremony, while when our envoy comes to their quarters there is food but no wine. Each side follows its own established practice and need not be the same.

sentences.zh: 古者宴禮設食以示慈惠，今遽更之，恐遠人有疑，失朝廷寵待臣子之意。

translations.literal: In antiquity banquet ceremony set out food to display kindness and favor; to change it abruptly now may cause distant people to doubt and lose the court's intent to cherish and treat envoy-subjects generously.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity banquet ceremony set out food to display kindness and favor. To change it abruptly now may cause distant peoples to doubt the court and lose the intent behind the court's generous treatment of envoys.

sentences.zh: 」乃命止如舊。

translations.literal: " He then ordered that it stop and remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then ordered that matters remain as before.

sentences.zh: 正大元年十月，夏國遣使修好。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Zhengda, the Xia state sent envoys to restore friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Zhengda, the Western Xia sent envoys to restore friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，夏國和議定，以兄事金，各用本國年號，定擬使者見辭儀注雲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year, the Xia peace agreement was settled: they treated Jin as an elder brother state, each used its own reign title, and the prescribed ceremonies for envoys' audiences and farewells were fixed as follows.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year, the peace agreement with Western Xia was settled. Xia would treat Jin as an elder brother state, each side would use its own reign title, and the prescribed ceremonies for envoys' audiences and farewells were fixed as follows.

sentences.zh: 蓋夏人自天會議和，臣屬於金八十餘年，無兵革事。

translations.literal: For the Xia people, from the Tianhui peace agreement they had been subjects of Jin for more than eighty years without military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia had been subjects of Jin for more than eighty years since the Tianhui peace agreement, without military conflict between them.

sentences.zh: 及貞祐之初，小有侵掠，以至構難十年，兩國俱敝，至是，始以兄弟之國成和。

translations.literal: By the beginning of Zhenyou there were small raids and plunder, leading to ten years of strife; both states were worn down, and only then did they achieve peace as brother states.
translations.idiomatic: By the beginning of Zhenyou there had been small raids and plunder, leading to ten years of strife that exhausted both states. Only then did they achieve peace as brother states.

sentences.zh: 十月，遣禮部尚書奧敦良弼、大理卿裴滿欽甫、侍御史烏古孫弘毅為報成使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, the Director of the Court of Judicial Review Peiman Qinfu, and the Attending Censor Wugusun Hongyi were sent as envoys to report the completion of the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, the Director of the Court of Judicial Review Peiman Qinfu, and the Attending Censor Wugusun Hongyi were dispatched as envoys to report the completion of the agreement.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，夏人告哀，遣中大夫完顏履信為弔祭使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, the Xia people reported mourning and Wanyan Lüxin, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, was sent as condolence envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, the Western Xia reported mourning, and Wanyan Lüxin, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, was dispatched as condolence envoy.

sentences.zh: 夏人以兵事方殷，各停使聘。

translations.literal: Because the Xia people's military affairs were then pressing, each side suspended envoy missions.
translations.idiomatic: Because military affairs were then pressing for both sides, each suspended envoy missions.

sentences.zh: 四年，遣王立之來聘，未複命而夏亡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Wang Lizhi was sent on a friendly mission, but before he could report back Xia perished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wang Lizhi was sent on a friendly mission, but before he could report back, Western Xia had fallen.

sentences.zh: 新定夏使儀注

translations.literal: Newly fixed ceremonial regulations for Xia envoys
translations.idiomatic: Newly Fixed Ceremonial Regulations for Western Xia Envoys

sentences.zh: 夏國使、副及參議各一，謂之使。

translations.literal: The Xia state's envoy, deputy, and one counsellor each were called the mission.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia mission consisted of one envoy, one deputy, and one counsellor.

sentences.zh: 都管三。

translations.literal: Three chief stewards.
translations.idiomatic: There were three chief stewards.

sentences.zh: 上節、中節各五、下節二十四，謂之三節人從。

translations.literal: Five upper-rank attendants, five middle-rank attendants, and twenty-four lower-rank attendants were called the three-rank mission staff.
translations.idiomatic: There were five upper-rank attendants, five middle-rank attendants, and twenty-four lower-rank attendants, collectively called the three-rank mission staff.

sentences.zh: 報至行省，差接伴使與書表人迓於境。

translations.literal: When notice reached the branch secretariat, a reception envoy and document officers were dispatched to welcome them at the border.
translations.idiomatic: When notice reached the branch secretariat, a reception envoy and document officers were dispatched to welcome the mission at the border.

sentences.zh: 入界，則先具驛程腰宿之次。

translations.literal: Upon entering the frontier, relay stages and overnight lodging stops were first prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering the frontier, relay stages and overnight lodging stops were prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 始至京兆行省，翌日賜宴，至河南行省亦然，謂之來宴。

translations.literal: When they first reached the Jingzhao branch secretariat, a banquet was granted the next day; the same applied at the Henan branch secretariat; this was called the arrival banquet.
translations.idiomatic: When they first reached the Jingzhao branch secretariat, a banquet was granted the next day. The same applied at the Henan branch secretariat. This was called the arrival banquet.

sentences.zh: 將至京，遣內侍一人以油絹複韜三銀盒，貯湯樂二十六品，逆于近境尉氏縣賜之。

translations.literal: As they were about to reach the capital, one inner attendant was sent with three silver boxes wrapped in oiled silk covers, holding twenty-six kinds of medicinal broth, to meet them at Weishi County in the near frontier and grant them.
translations.idiomatic: As they were nearing the capital, one inner attendant was sent ahead to Weishi County in the near frontier with three silver boxes wrapped in oiled silk covers, holding twenty-six kinds of medicinal broth, and granted them to the mission.

sentences.zh: 至恩華館舊名燕賓館，承安三年更名更衣，由宜照門入，預差館伴使、副使二員，書表四人，牽攏官三十人以俟。

translations.literal: They reached the Enhua Lodge, formerly called the Lodge for Entertaining Guests; in the third year of Cheng'an it was renamed the Dressing Lodge; they entered by the Gate of Suitable Illumination; two hostel escorts, four document officers, and thirty leading officers had been pre-assigned to await them.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the Enhua Lodge, formerly called the Lodge for Entertaining Guests and renamed the Dressing Lodge in the third year of Cheng'an. They entered by the Gate of Suitable Illumination, where two hostel escorts, four document officers, and thirty leading officers had been assigned to await them.

sentences.zh: 來使三節人從至會同館，謂之聚廳，先以館伴使名銜付之，而使者亦以其銜呈，然後使、副、都管、上中節人從以次見館伴使。

translations.literal: The incoming mission's three-rank staff reached the Hall of Joint Harmony, called the Assembly Hall; first the hostel escort's name and title were delivered to them, and the envoys also presented their titles; then the envoy, deputy, chief stewards, and upper- and middle-rank staff in turn met the hostel escort.
translations.idiomatic: The mission's three-rank staff reached the Hall of Joint Harmony, called the Assembly Hall. First the hostel escort's name and title were delivered to them, and the envoys presented their own titles in return. Then the envoy, deputy, chief stewards, and upper- and middle-rank staff met the hostel escort in turn.

sentences.zh: 接伴使初相見之儀亦然。

translations.literal: The protocol for the reception envoy's first meeting was the same.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol for the reception envoy's first meeting was the same.

sentences.zh: 次以館伴所書表見人使，館伴所牽攏官與下節人互相參見，畢，乃請館伴、接伴人，使、副，各公服齊出幕次，對行上廳欄子外，館伴在北，對立。

translations.literal: Next the hostel escort's written list of persons was used to meet the envoys; the hostel escort's leading officers and the lower-rank staff paid mutual visits; when finished, the hostel escort, reception personnel, envoy, and deputy were each invited in formal dress to leave the tent quarters together, walk opposite one another outside the upper hall railing, with the hostel escort on the north facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Next, using the hostel escort's written list of persons, the envoys were received. The hostel escort's leading officers and the lower-rank staff paid mutual visits. When this was finished, the hostel escort, reception personnel, envoy, and deputy were invited in formal dress to leave the tent quarters together and walk opposite one another outside the upper hall railing, with the hostel escort on the north side facing them.

sentences.zh: 先接伴揖，次來使副與館伴互展狀，揖，各傳示，再揖。

translations.literal: First the reception envoy bowed; next the incoming envoy and deputy and the hostel escort exchanged presentation documents and bowed; each side transmitted them for display and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: First the reception envoy bowed. Next the incoming envoy and deputy and the hostel escort exchanged presentation documents and bowed. Each side transmitted them for display and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 各就位，請收笏坐，先湯，次酒三盞，置果殽。

translations.literal: Each took his place; they were asked to put away their tablets and sit; first broth, then three rounds of wine, with fruits and delicacies set out.
translations.idiomatic: Each took his place and was asked to put away his court tablet and sit down. Broth was served first, then three rounds of wine with fruits and delicacies.

sentences.zh: 茶罷，執笏，近前齊起，欄子外館伴在南，對立。

translations.literal: When tea was finished, they took up their tablets, rose together and came forward; outside the railing the hostel escort stood on the south facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: When tea was finished, they took up their tablets and rose together. Outside the railing the hostel escort stood on the south side facing them.

sentences.zh: 先館伴揖，次展接伴辭狀，相別揖，各傳示，再揖，通揖分位。

translations.literal: First the hostel escort bowed; next the reception farewell document was displayed; they bowed in parting; each side transmitted it for display and bowed again; they bowed together and separated to their places.
translations.idiomatic: First the hostel escort bowed. Next the reception farewell document was displayed and they bowed in parting. Each side transmitted it for display and bowed again, then bowed together and separated to their places.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇帝遣使撫問。

translations.literal: That day the emperor sent an envoy to offer comforting inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor sent an envoy to offer comforting inquiry.

sentences.zh: 天使至館，轉銜如館伴初見之儀。

translations.literal: When the imperial envoy reached the hostel, titles were exchanged according to the hostel escort's first-meeting protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial envoy reached the hostel, titles were exchanged according to the same protocol used for the hostel escort's first meeting.

sentences.zh: 館伴與天使、來使副各公服，齊行至位，對立。

translations.literal: The hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy and deputy each in formal dress walked together to their places and faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: The hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy and deputy, each in formal dress, walked together to their places and faced one another.

sentences.zh: 請來使副升拜褥望闕立，次請天使升拜褥稍前立。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy were asked to ascend the bowing mat and stand facing the palace gate; next the imperial envoy was asked to ascend the bowing mat and stand slightly forward.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy were asked to step onto the bowing mat and stand facing the palace gate. The imperial envoy was then asked onto the bowing mat to stand slightly forward.

sentences.zh: 來使副鞠躬，天使言：「有敕。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy bowed; the imperial envoy said: "There is an edict.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy bowed. The imperial envoy said: "There is an edict.

sentences.zh: 」乃再拜鞠躬。

translations.literal: " They then bowed again and bowed with bent body.
translations.idiomatic: " They then bowed again with bent body.

sentences.zh: 天使口宣辭畢，復位。

translations.literal: When the imperial envoy had finished orally announcing the message, he returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial envoy had finished orally announcing the message, he returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 來使再拜，舞蹈，三拜，復位立。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and returned to stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 來使與天使各展狀，相見揖，次館伴揖。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and imperial envoy each displayed their documents, bowed in meeting, and then the hostel escort bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and imperial envoy each displayed their documents and bowed in meeting. The hostel escort then bowed.

sentences.zh: 來使令人傳示，請館伴、天使與來使對行上廳，各赴椅子立，通揖。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy had a messenger transmit the request that the hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy walk opposite one another up to the hall, each go to his chair and stand, and bow together.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy had a messenger request that the hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy walk opposite one another up to the hall, each take his chair, and bow together.

sentences.zh: 謹收笏坐，湯酒殽茶並如前，畢，執笏，近前，齊請起，至拜褥，依前對立。

translations.literal: They respectfully put away their tablets and sat; broth, wine, delicacies, and tea followed as before; when finished they took up their tablets, came forward, were all asked to rise, went to the bowing mat, and faced one another as before.
translations.idiomatic: They respectfully put away their tablets and sat down. Broth, wine, delicacies, and tea followed as before. When finished, they took up their tablets, came forward, rose together, went to the bowing mat, and faced one another as before.

sentences.zh: 請來使副升褥位，進表謝撫問，再拜，副使平立，使跪奉表，天使近前搢笏受之，出笏復位，來使就拜，退，複對立。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy were asked to ascend the mat position and present a memorial thanking the comforting inquiry; they bowed again; the deputy stood level; the envoy knelt and presented the memorial; the imperial envoy came forward, tucked in his tablet to receive it, produced his tablet and returned to place; the incoming envoy completed his bow, withdrew, and again faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy were asked onto the mat to present a memorial thanking the court for the comforting inquiry. They bowed again. The deputy stood upright while the envoy knelt and presented the memorial. The imperial envoy came forward, tucked in his tablet to receive it, then produced his tablet and returned to his place. The incoming envoy completed his bow, withdrew, and they again faced one another.

sentences.zh: 來使令人傳示館伴，依例書送天使土物，畢，展天使辭狀，相別揖，次館伴揖，各請分位。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy had a messenger transmit to the hostel escort that local products were to be sent in writing to the imperial envoy according to precedent; when finished the imperial envoy's farewell document was displayed; they bowed in parting; then the hostel escort bowed; each was asked to his separate place.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy had a messenger inform the hostel escort that local products were to be sent in writing to the imperial envoy according to precedent. When this was finished, the imperial envoy's farewell document was displayed. They bowed in parting, then the hostel escort bowed, and each was asked to his separate place.

sentences.zh: 是後，每旦暮傳示，並牽隴官聲喏如儀。

translations.literal: After this, every morning and evening messages were transmitted, and the leading officers' ceremonial calls followed protocol.
translations.idiomatic: After this, messages were transmitted every morning and evening, and the leading officers' ceremonial calls followed protocol.

sentences.zh: 到館之明日，遣使賜酒果，天使初至轉銜後，望拜傳宣皆如撫問之儀。

translations.literal: On the day after arrival at the hostel, an envoy was sent to grant wine and fruit; after the imperial envoy's first arrival and exchange of titles, the bow toward the palace and transmitted announcement all followed the comforting-inquiry protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the day after arrival at the hostel, an envoy was sent to grant wine and fruit. After the imperial envoy's first arrival and exchange of titles, the bow toward the palace and transmitted announcement all followed the comforting-inquiry protocol.

sentences.zh: 使副單跪，以酒果過其側，拜、舞蹈如儀。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy knelt on one knee as the wine and fruit passed by their side; they bowed and performed the ritual dance according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy knelt on one knee as the wine and fruit passed by. They bowed and performed the ritual dance according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 上廳湯酒茶畢，詣拜褥位，跪進謝賜酒果表，贈天使土物皆如撫問使禮，押酒果軍亦有土物之贈。

translations.literal: When the upper-hall broth, wine, and tea were finished, they went to the bowing mat position, knelt and presented a memorial thanking the grant of wine and fruit; presenting local products to the imperial envoy followed the comforting-inquiry envoy protocol, and the escort troops for the wine and fruit also received gifts of local products.
translations.idiomatic: When the upper-hall broth, wine, and tea were finished, they went to the bowing mat, knelt, and presented a memorial thanking the court for the grant of wine and fruit. Presenting local products to the imperial envoy followed the comforting-inquiry protocol, and the escort troops for the wine and fruit also received gifts of local products.

sentences.zh: 乃命閣門副使至館習儀，初轉銜前後皆如館伴相見之儀。

translations.literal: The Gate Office deputy commissioner was then ordered to come to the hostel to rehearse the ceremony; before and after the first exchange of titles it all followed the hostel escort meeting protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office deputy commissioner was then ordered to come to the hostel to rehearse the ceremony. Before and after the first exchange of titles, everything followed the hostel escort meeting protocol.

sentences.zh: 湯茶罷，館伴閣副傳示使副，來日入見，例當習儀。

translations.literal: When broth and tea were finished, the hostel escort and Gate deputy transmitted to the envoy and deputy that they would have an audience the next day and must by precedent rehearse the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When broth and tea were finished, the hostel escort and Gate deputy informed the envoy and deputy that they would have an audience the next day and must rehearse the ceremony as required.

sentences.zh: 來使副回傳示，習儀畢。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy sent back word that the rehearsal was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy sent back word that the rehearsal was finished.

sentences.zh: 第二盞後，當面勸習儀承受人酒一盞，先揖，飲酒，再拜退。

translations.literal: After the second round, the rehearsal instructor was urged face to face to drink one cup of wine; he bowed first, drank, bowed again, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After the second round, the rehearsal instructor was urged face to face to drink one cup of wine. He bowed first, drank, bowed again, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三盞果茶罷，執笏近前齊起，欄子外南為上，對立。

translations.literal: When the three rounds, fruit, and tea were finished, they took up their tablets, rose together and came forward; outside the railing the south was superior and they faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: When the three rounds, fruit, and tea were finished, they took up their tablets and rose together. Outside the railing the south side took precedence, and they faced one another.

sentences.zh: 以來日入見，故但揖而不展辭狀，分位。

translations.literal: Because they would have an audience the next day, they only bowed and did not display farewell documents, then separated to their places.
translations.idiomatic: Because they would have an audience the next day, they only bowed and did not display farewell documents, then separated to their places.

sentences.zh: 乃以入見榜子付閣門持去，以付禮進司。

translations.literal: The audience notice board was then given to the Gate Office to take away and deliver to the Presentation Office.
translations.idiomatic: The audience notice was then given to the Gate Office to take to the Presentation Office.

sentences.zh: 來使副以書送土物於引進使，及交進物軍員人等，閣門副及習儀承受人各贈土物。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy sent local products in writing to the Presentation Commissioner and to the troops and personnel handling presented goods; the Gate deputy and rehearsal instructor each received gifts of local products.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy sent local products in writing to the Presentation Commissioner and to the troops and personnel handling presented goods. The Gate deputy and rehearsal instructor each received gifts of local products.

sentences.zh: 第三日，入見。

translations.literal: On the third day they had their audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day they had their audience.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，都管、三節人從皆裹帶，館伴與來使副各公服，齊請赴馬台，館伴牽攏官喝：「排馬。

translations.literal: That day at dawn the chief stewards and three-rank staff all wore sashes; the hostel escort and incoming envoy and deputy each in formal dress were together invited to the horse platform; the hostel escort's leading officer called: "Arrange the horses.
translations.idiomatic: That day at dawn the chief stewards and three-rank staff all wore sashes. The hostel escort and incoming envoy and deputy, each in formal dress, were invited together to the horse platform. The hostel escort's leading officer called: "Arrange the horses.

sentences.zh: 」來使牽攏官喝：「牽馬。

translations.literal: " The incoming mission's leading officer called: "Lead the horses.
translations.idiomatic: " The incoming mission's leading officer called: "Lead the horses.

sentences.zh: 」各上馬張蓋。

translations.literal: " Each mounted and opened his canopy.
translations.idiomatic: " Each mounted and opened his canopy.

sentences.zh: 都管馬上奉書在使前，至中門外，以外為上，對立，先來使牽攏官兩聲喏，次館伴牽攏官亦然，齊揖，各傳示，再揖，請行。

translations.literal: The chief steward bore the letter on horseback before the envoy; they reached outside the central gate; the outside was superior and they faced one another; first the incoming mission's leading officer gave two ceremonial calls; next the hostel escort's leading officer did the same; they bowed together; each side transmitted for display; bowed again; and were invited to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The chief steward bore the letter on horseback before the envoy. They reached the area outside the central gate, where the outside took precedence, and faced one another. First the incoming mission's leading officer gave two ceremonial calls, then the hostel escort's leading officer did the same. They bowed together, each side transmitted the message for display, bowed again, and were invited to proceed.

sentences.zh: 至左掖門外五百步，館伴與使副乃左右易位而行。

translations.literal: Five hundred paces outside the Left Flank Gate, the hostel escort and envoy and deputy then exchanged left and right positions as they walked.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred paces outside the Left Flank Gate, the hostel escort and the envoy and deputy exchanged left and right positions as they walked.

sentences.zh: 揖畢，去門百步去傘下馬，出笏，對行。

translations.literal: When the bowing was finished, one hundred paces from the gate they closed their canopies and dismounted, produced their tablets, and walked opposite one another.
translations.idiomatic: When the bowing was finished, one hundred paces from the gate they closed their canopies and dismounted, produced their court tablets, and walked opposite one another.

sentences.zh: 凡後入稱賀、曲宴皆同是儀。

translations.literal: All later entries for congratulations and banquets followed this same protocol.
translations.idiomatic: All later entries for congratulations and banquets followed this same protocol.

sentences.zh: 來使人從持物者不得入門，牽攏官權收之。

translations.literal: Attendants of the incoming mission who carried objects were not permitted to enter the gate; the leading officers temporarily took charge of the items.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants of the incoming mission who carried objects were not permitted to enter the gate; the leading officers temporarily took charge of the items.

sentences.zh: 客省令二人傳示，館伴與來使各令人回傳示。

translations.literal: Two Guest Reception Office commissioners transmitted messages; the hostel escort and incoming envoy each had a messenger send back word.
translations.idiomatic: Two Guest Reception Office commissioners transmitted messages, and the hostel escort and incoming envoy each had a messenger send back word.

sentences.zh: 至客省幕前，館伴所書表在上立，齊揖，乃入幕。

translations.literal: They reached the front of the Guest Reception Office tent; the hostel escort's written list stood above; they bowed together and then entered the tent.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the front of the Guest Reception Office tent. The hostel escort's written list was posted above. They bowed together and then entered the tent.

sentences.zh: 先館伴所書表傳示，次來使書表傳示，依前欄子外立，先揖，當面勸酒一盞，再揖，退。

translations.literal: First the hostel escort's written list was transmitted for display; next the incoming envoy's written list was transmitted for display; they stood outside the railing as before; bowed first; were urged face to face to drink one cup of wine; bowed again; and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: First the hostel escort's written list was transmitted for display, then the incoming envoy's written list. They stood outside the railing as before, bowed, were urged face to face to drink one cup of wine, bowed again, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 引館伴來使入客省幕，內為上，對立揖畢，請分位立。

translations.literal: The hostel escort and incoming envoy were led into the Guest Reception Office tent; the inside was superior; when the facing bows were finished they were asked to stand in separate places.
translations.idiomatic: The hostel escort and incoming envoy were led into the Guest Reception Office tent, where the inside took precedence. When the facing bows were finished, they were asked to stand in separate places.

sentences.zh: 先館伴揖，次展客省起居狀，揖，各傳示，再揖，通揖。

translations.literal: First the hostel escort bowed; next the Guest Reception Office bow-of-respect document was displayed; they bowed; each side transmitted for display; bowed again; and bowed together.
translations.idiomatic: First the hostel escort bowed. Next the Guest Reception Office bow-of-respect document was displayed. They bowed, each side transmitted it for display, bowed again, and bowed together.

sentences.zh: 請赴位立，再揖，請收笏坐。

translations.literal: They were invited to their places to stand, bowed again, and were asked to put away their tablets and sit.
translations.idiomatic: They were invited to their places, bowed again, and were asked to put away their court tablets and sit down.

sentences.zh: 先湯，次酒三盞，各有果殽。

translations.literal: First broth, then three rounds of wine, each with fruits and delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Broth was served first, then three rounds of wine, each with fruits and delicacies.

sentences.zh: 第二盞酒畢，客省乃傳示來使，請都管、上中節勸酒。

translations.literal: When the second round of wine was finished, the Guest Reception Office transmitted to the incoming envoy a request that the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff be urged to drink.
translations.idiomatic: When the second round of wine was finished, the Guest Reception Office informed the incoming envoy that the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff should be urged to drink.

sentences.zh: 回傳示畢，引都管、上中節於幕次前階下排立，先揖，飲酒，再揖，引退。

translations.literal: When the return message was finished, the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led to line up below the steps before the tent quarters; they bowed first, drank, bowed again, and were led back.
translations.idiomatic: When the return message was finished, the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led to line up below the steps before the tent quarters. They bowed, drank, bowed again, and were led back.

sentences.zh: 第三盞酒畢，茶罷，執笏，近前齊起，幕次前立，通揖畢，各歸本幕次。

translations.literal: When the third round of wine and tea were finished, they took up their tablets, rose together and came forward, stood before the tent quarters, finished bowing together, and each returned to his own tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: When the third round of wine and tea were finished, they took up their tablets and rose together. They stood before the tent quarters, bowed together, and each returned to his own quarters.

sentences.zh: 俟殿上小起居畢，宰執升殿，余臣分班退，閣使奏來使見榜子。

translations.literal: They waited until the minor bow of respect on the hall floor was finished, the chief ministers ascended the hall, and the remaining officials filed out by formation; the Gate commissioner reported the incoming envoy's audience notice.
translations.idiomatic: They waited until the minor bow of respect in the hall was finished, the chief ministers had ascended the hall, and the remaining officials had filed out by formation. The Gate commissioner then announced the incoming envoy's audience notice.

sentences.zh: 乃先請館伴入班。

translations.literal: The hostel escort was then first invited into formation.
translations.idiomatic: The hostel escort was then invited into formation first.

sentences.zh: 俟閣門招引，乃請客省與來使副對立於幕前，外為上。

translations.literal: When the Gate Office summoned them, the Guest Reception Office and incoming envoy and deputy were invited to face one another before the tent; the outside was superior.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gate Office summoned them, the Guest Reception Office and the incoming envoy and deputy were invited to face one another before the tent, with the outside taking precedence.

sentences.zh: 使者奉書，揖畢對行，至三門外，與引揖閣副揖。

translations.literal: The envoy bore the letter; when the bowing was finished they walked opposite one another to outside the Triple Gate and bowed with the ushering Gate deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy bore the letter. When the bowing was finished they walked opposite one another to outside the Triple Gate and bowed with the ushering Gate deputy.

sentences.zh: 使奉書，副出笏後隨，左上露臺殿簷柱外，奉書單跪舊儀於丹墀內奉書，閣使接書，使副就拜，立。

translations.literal: The envoy bore the letter; the deputy produced his tablet and followed behind; they ascended left to outside the hall eaves columns on the open terrace; the envoy knelt on one knee to present the letter; by the old protocol the letter was presented inside the red terrace; the Gate commissioner received the letter; the envoy and deputy completed their bow and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy bore the letter while the deputy produced his tablet and followed behind. They ascended on the left to the area outside the hall eaves columns on the open terrace. The envoy knelt on one knee to present the letter. Under the old protocol the letter had been presented inside the court terrace; the Gate commissioner received it, and the envoy and deputy completed their bow and stood.

sentences.zh: 閣使右入欄子內，奏：「封全。

translations.literal: The Gate commissioner entered the railing on the right and reported: "The seal is intact.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate commissioner entered the railing on the right and reported: "The seal is intact.

sentences.zh: 」轉讀畢，故事皆不讀。

translations.literal: " When the reading aloud was finished, by precedent it was not read in full.
translations.idiomatic: " When the reading aloud was finished, by precedent the letter was not read in full.

sentences.zh: 引使副入殿欄子內，揖使副鞠躬再拜，引少前跪奏：「弟大夏皇帝致問兄大金皇帝，聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were led inside the hall railing; they were prompted to bow with bent body and bow again; the envoy was led slightly forward to kneel and report: "The younger brother, the Great Xia emperor, sends inquiry to the elder brother, the Great Jin emperor: may Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were led inside the hall railing. They were prompted to bow with bent body and bow again. The envoy was led slightly forward to kneel and report: "The younger brother, the Great Western Xia emperor, sends inquiry to the elder brother, the Great Jin emperor: may Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」再拜，興，復位。

translations.literal: " He bowed again, rose, and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed again, rose, and returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乃宣問夏皇帝，使副鞠躬受旨，畢，引使少前跪奏：「弟大夏皇帝聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: The emperor then announced an inquiry concerning the Xia emperor; the envoy and deputy bowed with bent body and received the instruction; when finished the envoy was led slightly forward to kneel and report: "The younger brother, the Great Xia emperor, enjoys ten thousand blessings of sacred person.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then announced an inquiry concerning the Western Xia emperor. The envoy and deputy bowed with bent body and received the instruction. The envoy was then led slightly forward to kneel and report: "The younger brother, the Great Western Xia emperor, enjoys ten thousand blessings of sacred person.

sentences.zh: 」拜，復位，立。

translations.literal: " He bowed, returned to his place, and stood.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed, returned to his place, and stood.

sentences.zh: 齊退，左下階，至丹墀北向立。

translations.literal: All withdrew together, descended the steps on the left, and came to stand facing north on the red terrace.
translations.idiomatic: They all withdrew together, descended the steps on the left, and stood facing north on the court terrace.

sentences.zh: 以禮物右入左出，盡，揖使副傍折通班。

translations.literal: Tribute gifts entered from the right and exited from the left until finished; the envoy and deputy were prompted to turn aside through the formation.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute gifts were brought in from the right and taken out on the left until all had been presented. The envoy and deputy were led through the formation.

sentences.zh: 再引至丹墀，舞蹈，五拜，不出班代奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: They were led again to the red terrace, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and without leaving formation the deputy reported on their behalf: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: They were led again to the court terrace, performed the ritual dance and five prostrations, and without leaving formation the deputy reported on their behalf: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」畢，再拜。

translations.literal: " When finished, they bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " When finished, they bowed again.

sentences.zh: 引使副前，雙跪，皇帝遣人勞問，復位，謝恩，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were led forward and knelt on both knees; the emperor sent someone to offer comforting inquiry; they returned to place, thanked for grace, and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were led forward and knelt on both knees. The emperor sent someone to offer comforting inquiry. They returned to their places, offered thanks for imperial favor, and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 再揖使副出班，謝面天顏，復位，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were again prompted to leave formation and thank the emperor for beholding his countenance; they returned to place and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were again prompted to step out of formation and thank the emperor for granting them an audience. They returned to their places and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 再揖閣副鞠躬，引使出班，謝遠差接伴兼賜湯藥諸物，復位，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The Gate deputy was again prompted to bow with bent body; the envoy was led out of formation to thank the long-distance escort and reception and the grant of medicinal broth and other items; he returned to place and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate deputy was again prompted to bow with bent body. The envoy was led out of formation to thank the court for the long-distance escort and reception and for the medicinal broth and other gifts. He returned to his place and performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: The herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」引右出，至三門階下，與閣副揖別，與客省同行至幕次前對揖，各歸幕次。

translations.literal: " They were led out on the right to below the steps of the Triple Gate, bowed in parting with the Gate deputy, walked together with the Guest Reception Office to the front of the tent quarters and bowed facing one another, and each returned to his tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: " They were led out on the right to below the steps of the Triple Gate, bowed in parting with the Gate deputy, walked together with the Guest Reception Office to the front of the tent quarters and bowed facing one another, and each returned to his quarters.

sentences.zh: 引都管、上中節左入，丹墀立，下節於門外階下立，齊鞠躬通名，先再拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led in from the left to stand on the red terrace; the lower-rank staff stood below the steps outside the gate; all bowed with bent body and announced their names; they bowed again first; without leaving formation they reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led in from the left to stand on the court terrace, while the lower-rank staff stood below the steps outside the gate. All bowed with bent body and announced their names, then bowed again. Without leaving formation they reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」再拜。

translations.literal: " They bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again.

sentences.zh: 下節鞠躬聲喏，初一拜呼「萬歲」，次一拜呼「萬歲」，臨起呼「萬萬歲」。

translations.literal: The lower-rank staff bowed with bent body and gave ceremonial calls: at the first bow they called "Long live"; at the second bow they called "Long live"; as they were about to rise they called "Long live ten thousand times."
translations.idiomatic: The lower-rank staff bowed with bent body and gave ceremonial calls: at the first bow they called "Long live"; at the second bow they called "Long live"; as they were about to rise they called "Long live ten thousand times."

sentences.zh: 喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: The herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」平立，引右出。

translations.literal: " They stood level and were led out on the right.
translations.idiomatic: " They stood at ease and were led out on the right.

sentences.zh: 乃賜使者衣，拜舞皆如賜酒果之儀，畢，使者與天使對立。

translations.literal: Robes were then granted to the envoy; the bows and dance all followed the protocol for granting wine and fruit; when finished the envoy and imperial envoy faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: Robes were then granted to the envoy. The bows and dance all followed the protocol for granting wine and fruit. When finished, the envoy and imperial envoy faced one another.

sentences.zh: 次請都管 、三節人從望闕立，天使稍前立，都管人從鞠躬，天使傳敕，拜謝如使儀，就拜畢，謝恩再拜。

translations.literal: Next the chief stewards and three-rank staff were invited to stand facing the palace gate; the imperial envoy stood slightly forward; the chief stewards and staff bowed with bent body; the imperial envoy transmitted the edict; they bowed in thanks according to the envoy protocol; when the bow was finished they thanked for grace and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: Next the chief stewards and three-rank staff were invited to stand facing the palace gate. The imperial envoy stood slightly forward. The chief stewards and staff bowed with bent body as the imperial envoy transmitted the edict. They bowed in thanks according to the envoy protocol, and when the bow was finished they offered thanks for imperial favor and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 下節鞠躬聲喏，如入見儀，乃再引入，賜以酒食，閣門招、客省皆如入見儀。

translations.literal: The lower-rank staff bowed with bent body and gave ceremonial calls as in the audience protocol; they were then led in again and granted wine and food; the Gate summons and Guest Reception Office all followed the audience protocol.
