translations.idiomatic: The lower-rank staff bowed with bent body and gave ceremonial calls as in the audience protocol. They were then led in again and granted wine and food. The Gate summons and Guest Reception Office all followed the audience protocol.

sentences.zh: 至丹墀，謝賜衣物，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: They came to the red terrace, thanked the grant of robes, bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and bowed with bent body.
translations.idiomatic: They came to the court terrace, thanked the court for the grant of robes, bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and bowed with bent body.

sentences.zh: 贊：「有敕賜酒食。

translations.literal: The announcer said: "There is an edict granting wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer said: "There is an edict granting wine and food.

sentences.zh: 」舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: " They performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: " They performed the ritual dance and five prostrations.

sentences.zh: 喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: The herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」引右出，如前儀，歸幕。

translations.literal: " They were led out on the right, following the previous protocol, and returned to the tent.
translations.idiomatic: " They were led out on the right according to the previous protocol and returned to the tent.

sentences.zh: 乃請出，館伴與使副幕前對立揖，各傳示，再揖，請行。

translations.literal: They were then invited to leave; the hostel escort and envoy and deputy bowed facing one another before the tent; each side transmitted for display; bowed again; and were invited to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: They were then invited to leave. The hostel escort and the envoy and deputy bowed facing one another before the tent, each side transmitted the message for display, bowed again, and were invited to proceed.

sentences.zh: 至元下馬所，複左右易位而行，揖畢，各收笏，上馬至館。

translations.literal: They reached the original dismounting place, again exchanged left and right positions as they walked; when the bowing was finished each put away his tablet, mounted, and went to the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the original dismounting place and again exchanged left and right positions as they walked. When the bowing was finished, each put away his court tablet, mounted, and returned to the hostel.

sentences.zh: 又左右易位入門，內為上，對立。

translations.literal: They again exchanged left and right positions upon entering the gate; the inside was superior and they faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: They again exchanged left and right positions upon entering the gate, where the inside took precedence, and faced one another.

sentences.zh: 先來使牽攏官，次館伴牽攏官，各聲喏，再拜揖，畢，請分位。

translations.literal: First the incoming mission's leading officer, then the hostel escort's leading officer, each gave ceremonial calls, bowed again and bowed, and when finished were asked to their separate places.
translations.idiomatic: First the incoming mission's leading officer, then the hostel escort's leading officer, each gave ceremonial calls and bowed again. When finished, they were asked to their separate places.

sentences.zh: 乃以押伴使賜宴於館。

translations.literal: Then the escort commissioner was sent to grant a banquet at the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: Then the escort commissioner was sent to host a banquet at the hostel.

sentences.zh: 押伴至館，轉名銜回畢，與館伴、來使公服，齊詣褥位對立，押伴稍前立。

translations.literal: When the escort commissioner reached the hostel and had finished exchanging names and titles in return, he, the hostel escort, and the incoming envoy in formal dress together went to the mat positions and faced one another, with the escort commissioner standing slightly forward.
translations.idiomatic: When the escort commissioner reached the hostel and had finished exchanging names and titles, he, the hostel escort, and the incoming envoy, all in formal dress, went together to the bowing mats and faced one another, with the escort commissioner standing slightly forward.

sentences.zh: 先請押伴、館伴上褥位，望闕拜，謝坐，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，起。

translations.literal: First the escort commissioner and hostel escort were invited onto the mat positions; they bowed toward the palace gate, thanked for the seats, bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: First the escort commissioner and hostel escort were invited onto the bowing mats. They bowed toward the palace gate and thanked the court for the seats, bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and rose.

sentences.zh: 先請押伴上副階上立，乃引使副上褥位，望闕亦謝坐，儀同上。

translations.literal: First the escort commissioner was invited to stand on the secondary steps; then the envoy and deputy were led onto the mat positions; facing the palace gate they also thanked for the seats, following the same protocol as above.
translations.idiomatic: First the escort commissioner was invited to stand on the secondary steps. Then the envoy and deputy were led onto the bowing mats, where they also bowed toward the palace gate and thanked the court for the seats, following the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 乃與館伴對行上廳。

translations.literal: Then they walked opposite the hostel escort up to the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Then they walked opposite the hostel escort up to the hall.

sentences.zh: 押伴在副階上，與使副展參狀。

translations.literal: The escort commissioner, on the secondary steps, displayed presentation documents with the envoy and deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The escort commissioner, standing on the secondary steps, exchanged presentation documents with the envoy and deputy.

sentences.zh: 來使副先令人報上聞，押伴回傳示，再揖。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy first had a messenger report to the higher authorities; the escort commissioner sent back a transmitted message for display; they bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy first had a messenger report upward. The escort commissioner sent back a message for display, and they bowed again.

sentences.zh: 請押伴先入，于卓前椅位立。

translations.literal: The escort commissioner was invited to enter first and stand at the chair before the table.
translations.idiomatic: The escort commissioner was invited to enter first and take his chair before the table.

sentences.zh: 館伴與使副對揖，各就位立，通揖，請端笏坐，湯入，乃于拜席上排立都管人從。

translations.literal: The hostel escort and envoy and deputy bowed facing one another; each took his place and stood; they bowed together; were asked to sit holding their tablets properly; broth was served; then the chief stewards and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.
translations.idiomatic: The hostel escort and the envoy and deputy bowed facing one another, each took his place, and bowed together. They were asked to sit holding their tablets properly. When broth was served, the chief stewards and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.

sentences.zh: 湯盞出，揖起，押伴等離位立。

translations.literal: When the broth bowls were removed, they bowed and rose; the escort commissioner and others left their seats and stood.
translations.idiomatic: When the broth bowls were removed, they bowed and rose. The escort commissioner and the others left their seats and stood.

sentences.zh: 都管人從鞠躬拜，下節人聲喏，如入見儀。

translations.literal: The chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body and bowed; the lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls, as in the audience protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body. The lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls, following the audience protocol.

sentences.zh: 呼「萬歲」，畢，喝：「押伴及使副皆就坐。

translations.literal: They called "Long live"; when finished the herald called: "The escort commissioner and envoy and deputy shall all take their seats.
translations.idiomatic: They called "Long live." When finished, the herald called: "The escort commissioner and the envoy and deputy shall all take their seats.

sentences.zh: 」引三都管、上中節分左右上廳，南入，北為上，下節在西廊下立。

translations.literal: " The three chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led left and right up to the hall, entering from the south with the north as superior; the lower-rank staff stood below the west corridor.
translations.idiomatic: " The three chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led up to the hall on left and right, entering from the south with the north side as superior. The lower-rank staff stood below the west corridor.

sentences.zh: 候押伴等初盞畢，樂聲盡，坐。

translations.literal: When the escort commissioner and others had finished the first round, the music ceased, and they sat.
translations.idiomatic: When the escort commissioner and the others had finished the first round and the music ceased, they sat down.

sentences.zh: 至三盞下，食畢，四盞下，酒畢。

translations.literal: When the third round was served, food was finished; when the fourth round was served, wine was finished.
translations.idiomatic: When the third round was served, the meal was finished. When the fourth round was served, the wine was finished.

sentences.zh: 押伴傳示來使，面勸都管、上中節酒一盞，來使答上聞，以都管、上中節於副階下排立，先揖，飲，傳台旨勸，再揖，退。

translations.literal: The escort commissioner transmitted to the incoming envoy a request to urge the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff face to face to drink one cup of wine; the incoming envoy answered to the higher authorities; the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were arranged in ranks below the secondary steps; they bowed first, drank, and were urged with a transmitted court instruction; bowed again and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The escort commissioner informed the incoming envoy that the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff should be urged face to face to drink one cup of wine. The incoming envoy replied upward. The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were arranged in ranks below the secondary steps. They bowed, drank as urged with a transmitted court instruction, bowed again, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至五盞下，酒畢，茶入。

translations.literal: When the fifth round was served, wine was finished, and tea was served.
translations.idiomatic: When the fifth round was served, the wine was finished and tea was brought in.

sentences.zh: 都管人從于拜席上排立，待茶罷，揖押伴等起，離位立，都管人從鞠躬，喝：「謝恩。

translations.literal: The chief stewards and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat; when tea was finished they bowed to the escort commissioner and others to rise; leaving their seats they stood; the chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body; the herald called: "Thank the grace received.
translations.idiomatic: The chief stewards and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat. When tea was finished, they bowed to signal the escort commissioner and the others to rise. Leaving their seats, they stood. The chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body as the herald called: "Offer thanks for imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 」拜，下節聲喏如上儀，就位立。

translations.literal: " They bowed; the lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls as in the protocol above, and took their places and stood.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed. The lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls as above, then took their places and stood.

sentences.zh: 請押伴等齊下廳，赴拜褥對立。

translations.literal: The escort commissioner and others were invited together down from the hall to the bowing mat to face one another.
translations.idiomatic: The escort commissioner and the others were invited down from the hall together to the bowing mat, where they faced one another.

sentences.zh: 先請使副就褥位，謝恩，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，復位。

translations.literal: First the envoy and deputy were invited to the mat positions to thank for grace; they bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: First the envoy and deputy were invited to the bowing mats to offer thanks for imperial favor. They bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and returned to their places.

sentences.zh: 乃請押伴、館伴就褥位，謝如上儀，復位。

translations.literal: Then the escort commissioner and hostel escort were invited to the mat positions to thank as in the protocol above, and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: Then the escort commissioner and hostel escort were invited to the bowing mats to offer thanks as above, and returned to their places.

sentences.zh: 第四日，命押宴官、賜宴官就館宴。

translations.literal: On the fourth day, banquet commissioners and banquet-granting officials were ordered to host a banquet at the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day, banquet commissioners and banquet-granting officials were ordered to host a banquet at the hostel.

sentences.zh: 先賜宴天使轉銜如前儀，各公服，請館伴、天使與來使就褥位對立。

translations.literal: First the banquet-granting imperial envoy exchanged titles as in the previous protocol; each in formal dress; the hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy were invited to the mat positions to face one another.
translations.idiomatic: First the banquet-granting imperial envoy exchanged titles as in the previous protocol. All in formal dress, the hostel escort, imperial envoy, and incoming envoy were invited to the bowing mats to face one another.

sentences.zh: 先請使副就褥位，望闕立。

translations.literal: First the envoy and deputy were invited to the mat positions and stood facing the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: First the envoy and deputy were invited to the bowing mats and stood facing the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 次請賜宴天使就褥位稍前，使副鞠躬，天使傳宣，使副拜謝，皆如前儀。

translations.literal: Next the banquet-granting imperial envoy was invited to the mat position slightly forward; the envoy and deputy bowed with bent body; the imperial envoy transmitted the announcement; the envoy and deputy bowed in thanks; all as in the previous protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Next the banquet-granting imperial envoy was invited to the bowing mat slightly forward. The envoy and deputy bowed with bent body as the imperial envoy transmitted the announcement. The envoy and deputy bowed in thanks, all as in the previous protocol.

sentences.zh: 使副與天使互展狀，起居，揖。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy and imperial envoy displayed documents to one another, exchanged greetings, and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy and the imperial envoy exchanged documents, exchanged greetings, and bowed.

sentences.zh: 次館伴揖，使副令人傳示館伴，依例請賜宴天使茶酒，館伴暫歸幕。

translations.literal: Next the hostel escort bowed; the envoy and deputy had a messenger transmit to the hostel escort a request that the banquet-granting imperial envoy be offered tea and wine according to precedent; the hostel escort temporarily returned to the tent.
translations.idiomatic: Next the hostel escort bowed. The envoy and deputy had a messenger request that the banquet-granting imperial envoy be offered tea and wine according to precedent. The hostel escort then temporarily returned to the tent.

sentences.zh: 來使副與天使主賓對行上廳，於西間內各詣椅位揖，收笏坐。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy and deputy and the imperial envoy as host and guest walked opposite one another up to the hall; within the west chamber each went to his chair, bowed, put away his tablet, and sat.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy and deputy and the imperial envoy, as host and guest, walked opposite one another up to the hall. In the west chamber each went to his chair, bowed, put away his tablet, and sat down.

sentences.zh: 先湯，次酒三盞，果殽。

translations.literal: First broth, then three rounds of wine, with fruits and delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: First broth, then three rounds of wine with fruits and delicacies.

sentences.zh: 茶罷，執笏，近前請起，賜宴天使暗退。

translations.literal: When tea was finished they took up their tablets, came forward, and were asked to rise; the banquet-granting imperial envoy withdrew discreetly.
translations.idiomatic: When tea was finished, they took up their tablets and came forward to rise. The banquet-granting imperial envoy withdrew discreetly.

sentences.zh: 請押宴使至褥位立，次請館伴齊就褥位，望闕再拜。

translations.literal: The banquet commissioner was invited to the mat position to stand; next the hostel escort was invited together to the mat positions and bowed again toward the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet commissioner was invited to the bowing mat to stand. Next the hostel escort was invited together onto the bowing mats and bowed again toward the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 平身，搢笏，鞠躬，三舞蹈，跪左膝三叩頭，出笏就拜，興，再拜復位，對立。

translations.literal: They stood level, tucked in their tablets, bowed with bent body, performed three ritual dances, knelt on the left knee and knocked their heads three times, produced their tablets and completed the bow, rose, bowed again, returned to their places, and faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: They stood upright, tucked in their tablets, and bowed with bent body. They performed three ritual dances, knelt on the left knee and knocked their heads three times, then produced their tablets to complete the bow. They rose, bowed again, returned to their places, and faced one another.

sentences.zh: 請押宴上廳。

translations.literal: The banquet commissioner was invited up to the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet commissioner was invited up to the hall.

sentences.zh: 次請來使副詣褥位，謝坐，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，請分階升廳，欄子外，內為上，對立。

translations.literal: Next the incoming envoy and deputy were invited to the mat positions to thank for the seats; they bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations; were invited to ascend the hall by separate staircases; outside the railing the inside was superior and they faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: Next the incoming envoy and deputy were invited to the bowing mats to thank the court for the seats. They bowed again and performed the ritual dance and three prostrations. They were invited to ascend the hall by separate staircases. Outside the railing, with the inside taking precedence, they faced one another.

sentences.zh: 先館伴揖，次互展押宴起居狀，相見，揖。

translations.literal: First the hostel escort bowed; next they displayed the banquet commissioner's greeting document to one another, bowed in meeting, and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: First the hostel escort bowed. Next they exchanged the banquet commissioner's greeting document, bowed in meeting, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 各傳示，再揖，通揖，請就位，詣椅位立。

translations.literal: Each side transmitted for display; bowed again; bowed together; were invited to their places; went to their chairs and stood.
translations.idiomatic: Each side transmitted the document for display and bowed again. They bowed together, were invited to their places, and went to their chairs.

sentences.zh: 通揖，請端笏坐，以禦宴不敢用踏床。

translations.literal: They bowed together; were asked to sit holding their tablets properly; because it was an imperial banquet they did not dare use footrests.
translations.idiomatic: They bowed together and were asked to sit holding their tablets properly. Because it was an imperial banquet, they did not dare use footrests.

sentences.zh: 湯入，都管、三節人從于拜席上排立。

translations.literal: Broth was served; the chief stewards and three-rank staff and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.
translations.idiomatic: When broth was served, the chief stewards and three-rank staff and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.

sentences.zh: 湯盞出，押宴離位立揖，都管人從鞠躬，下節人從聲喏，呼「萬歲」，如入見儀，喝：「各就坐。

translations.literal: When the broth bowls were removed, the banquet commissioner left his seat, stood, and bowed; the chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body; the lower-rank staff and attendants gave ceremonial calls; they called "Long live" as in the audience protocol; the herald called: "Each take your seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the broth bowls were removed, the banquet commissioner left his seat, stood, and bowed. The chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body. The lower-rank staff and attendants gave ceremonial calls and called "Long live" as in the audience protocol. The herald called: "Each take your seat.

sentences.zh: 」請押宴等坐。

translations.literal: " The banquet commissioner and others were invited to sit.
translations.idiomatic: " The banquet commissioner and the others were invited to sit.

sentences.zh: 引都管、上中節分左右上廳，北入，南為上，立。

translations.literal: The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led left and right up to the hall, entering from the north with the south as superior, and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led up to the hall on left and right, entering from the north with the south side as superior, and stood.

sentences.zh: 下節于西廊下南入，北為上，立。

translations.literal: The lower-rank staff below the west corridor entered from the south with the north as superior and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The lower-rank staff below the west corridor entered from the south, with the north side as superior, and stood.

sentences.zh: 候押宴等初盞畢，樂聲盡，坐。

translations.literal: When the banquet commissioner and others had finished the first round, the music ceased, and they sat.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet commissioner and the others had finished the first round and the music ceased, they sat down.

sentences.zh: 至五盞後食，六盞、七盞雜劇。

translations.literal: When the fifth round was served, food followed; at the sixth and seventh rounds there were variety performances.
translations.idiomatic: When the fifth round was served, food followed. At the sixth and seventh rounds there were variety performances.

sentences.zh: 八盞下，酒畢。

translations.literal: When the eighth round was served, wine was finished.
translations.idiomatic: When the eighth round was served, the wine was finished.

sentences.zh: 押宴傳示使副，依例請都管、上中節當面勸酒。

translations.literal: The banquet commissioner transmitted to the envoy and deputy a request that the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff be urged face to face to drink wine according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet commissioner informed the envoy and deputy that the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff should be urged face to face to drink wine according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 使者答上聞，複引都管、上中節於欄子外階下排立，先揖，飲酒，再揖，退。

translations.literal: The envoy answered to the higher authorities; the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were again led to stand in ranks below the steps outside the railing; they bowed first, drank wine, bowed again, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy replied upward. The chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were again led to stand in ranks below the steps outside the railing. They bowed, drank wine, bowed again, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至九盞下，酒畢，教坊退。

translations.literal: When the ninth round was served, wine was finished, and the Music Office withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the ninth round was served, the wine was finished and the Music Office withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乃請賜宴天使于幕次前。

translations.literal: Then the banquet-granting imperial envoy was invited before the tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Then the banquet-granting imperial envoy was invited before the tent quarters.

sentences.zh: 候茶入，乃于拜席排立都管、三節人從。

translations.literal: When tea was served, the chief stewards and three-rank staff and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.
translations.idiomatic: When tea was served, the chief stewards and three-rank staff and attendants were arranged in ranks on the bowing mat.

sentences.zh: 茶盞出，揖起，押宴官等離位立，揖，都管人從鞠躬，喝：「謝恩。

translations.literal: When the tea bowls were removed, they bowed and rose; the banquet commissioners and others left their seats and stood and bowed; the chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body; the herald called: "Thank the grace received.
translations.idiomatic: When the tea bowls were removed, they bowed and rose. The banquet commissioners and the others left their seats, stood, and bowed. The chief stewards and attendants bowed with bent body as the herald called: "Offer thanks for imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 」拜，下節聲喏，呼「萬歲」，如入見儀，齊鞠躬，喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: " They bowed; the lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls; they called "Long live" as in the audience protocol; all bowed with bent body; the herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed. The lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls and called "Long live" as in the audience protocol. All bowed with bent body as the herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」請押宴等官齊出，分階下廳，與天使對行至拜褥前立。

translations.literal: " The banquet commissioners and others were invited out together, descended the hall by separate staircases, walked opposite the imperial envoy to stand before the bowing mat.
translations.idiomatic: " The banquet commissioners and the others were invited out together, descended the hall by separate staircases, and walked opposite the imperial envoy to stand before the bowing mat.

sentences.zh: 請使副就位望闕謝恩，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，畢，依位立。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were invited to their places to thank for grace facing the palace gate; they bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations; when finished they stood in their places.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were invited to their places to offer thanks facing the palace gate. They bowed again, performed the ritual dance and three prostrations, and when finished stood in their places.

sentences.zh: 請押宴、館伴齊詣褥位謝恩。

translations.literal: The banquet commissioner and hostel escort were invited together to the mat positions to thank for grace.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet commissioner and hostel escort were invited together to the bowing mats to offer thanks for imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 來使乃進謝禦宴表，先再拜，平身立。

translations.literal: The incoming envoy then presented a memorial thanking the imperial banquet; he bowed again first and stood level.
translations.idiomatic: The incoming envoy then presented a memorial thanking the court for the imperial banquet. He bowed again first and stood upright.

sentences.zh: 使跪捧表，天使近前搢笏受表，出笏復位。

translations.literal: The envoy knelt and presented the memorial; the imperial envoy came forward, tucked in his tablet to receive the memorial, produced his tablet and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy knelt and presented the memorial. The imperial envoy came forward, tucked in his tablet to receive it, then produced his tablet and returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 使就拜，退復位，立。

translations.literal: The envoy completed his bow, withdrew and returned to his place, and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy completed his bow, withdrew to his place, and stood.

sentences.zh: 使副上聞，依例書送天使土物，領畢，天使即以物報之，然後展天使辭狀，再揖，次館伴揖，通揖，請分位。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy reported to the higher authorities; according to precedent they sent local products in writing to the imperial envoy; when received the imperial envoy reciprocated with gifts; then the imperial envoy's farewell document was displayed; they bowed again; next the hostel escort bowed; bowed together; and were invited to separate places.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy reported upward. According to precedent they sent local products in writing to the imperial envoy. When these were received, the imperial envoy reciprocated with gifts. Then the imperial envoy's farewell document was displayed. They bowed again, then the hostel escort bowed, they bowed together, and each was invited to his separate place.

sentences.zh: 是日，來使於宴下監酒等官及教坊人等皆有所贈。

translations.literal: That day the incoming envoy gave gifts to the wine-supervising officials below the banquet and to the Music Office personnel.
translations.idiomatic: That day the incoming envoy gave gifts to the wine-supervising officials at the banquet and to the Music Office personnel.

sentences.zh: 第五日，稱賀。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, felicitations were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day came the congratulations ceremony.

sentences.zh: 比至客省幕次對立，皆如入見儀。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the Guest Reception Office tent quarters to face one another, all followed the audience protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the Guest Reception Office quarters to face one another, everything followed the audience protocol.

sentences.zh: 至收笏坐，先湯，次酒三盞，畢，客省傳示來使，辭曰：「請都管、上中節當面勸酒。

translations.literal: When they put away their tablets and sat, first broth, then three rounds of wine; when finished the Guest Reception Office transmitted to the incoming envoy words saying: "Please urge the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff face to face to drink wine.
translations.idiomatic: When they put away their tablets and sat down, broth was served first, then three rounds of wine. When finished, the Guest Reception Office informed the incoming envoy: "Please urge the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff face to face to drink wine.

sentences.zh: 」回傳示畢，引都管、上中節於幕次前階下排立，先揖，飲酒，再揖，引退。

translations.literal: " When the reply had been transmitted, the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led to stand in ranks below the steps before the tent quarters; they bowed first, drank wine, bowed again, and were led to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: " When the reply had been transmitted, the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led to stand in ranks below the steps before the tent quarters. They bowed, drank wine, bowed again, and were led to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 至三盞酒畢，茶罷，出笏近前，齊請出幕次，前外為上，對立，通揖，分位，各歸幕次。

translations.literal: When the third round of wine was finished and tea was finished, they produced their tablets and came forward; all were invited out of the tent quarters; the front outside was superior and they faced one another; bowed together; separated to their places; and each returned to his tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: When the third round of wine and tea were finished, they produced their tablets and came forward. All were invited out of the tent quarters, where the front outside took precedence. They faced one another, bowed together, separated to their places, and each returned to his quarters.

sentences.zh: 候閣門招引時，請客省與使副幕次前，外為上，對立揖。

translations.literal: When awaiting the Gate Office summons, the Guest Reception Office and envoy and deputy were invited before the tent quarters; the outside was superior and they bowed facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: When awaiting the Gate Office summons, the Guest Reception Office and the envoy and deputy were invited before the tent quarters, where the outside took precedence, and bowed facing one another.

sentences.zh: 對行至門外階下，與引揖閣副揖。

translations.literal: Walking opposite one another they reached below the steps outside the gate and bowed with the ushering Gate deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Walking opposite one another, they reached below the steps outside the gate and bowed with the ushering Gate deputy.

sentences.zh: 引使副左入，與臣僚合班，至丹墀北向立定。

translations.literal: The envoy and deputy were led in from the left and joined the ministers' combined formation; they came to stand facing north on the red terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy and deputy were led in from the left and joined the ministers' combined formation. They came to stand facing north on the court terrace.

sentences.zh: 同臣僚先再拜，平身，搢笏，鞠躬，三舞蹈，跪左膝三叩頭，出笏就拜，興，再拜，平立。

translations.literal: Together with the ministers they bowed again first; stood level; tucked in their tablets; bowed with bent body; performed three ritual dances; knelt on the left knee and knocked their heads three times; produced their tablets and completed the bow; rose; bowed again; and stood level.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the ministers they bowed again first, then stood upright, tucked in their tablets, and bowed with bent body. They performed three ritual dances, knelt on the left knee and knocked their heads three times, then produced their tablets to complete the bow. They rose, bowed again, and stood at ease.

sentences.zh: 俟進酒致辭畢，再拜，宣徽使稱：「有制。

translations.literal: When the wine presentation and formal address were finished, they bowed again; the Palace Intendant declared: "There is an edict.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine presentation and formal address were finished, they bowed again. The Palace Intendant declared: "There is an edict.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜，宣答畢，先再拜，舞蹈，平立，分班。

translations.literal: " They bowed again; when the announcement and reply were finished they bowed again first, performed the ritual dance, stood level, and separated into ranks.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again. When the announcement and reply were finished, they bowed again first, performed the ritual dance, stood at ease, and separated into ranks.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝舉酒時，再拜，合班又再拜，上殿，夏使副在御座右第二行北端立。

translations.literal: When awaiting the emperor's raising of his cup, they bowed again; the combined formation bowed again; they ascended the hall; the Xia envoy and deputy stood at the north end of the second row to the right of the emperor's seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor raised his cup, they bowed again. The combined formation bowed again and ascended the hall. The Western Xia envoy and deputy stood at the north end of the second row to the right of the emperor's seat.

sentences.zh: 次引都管、上中節左入，至丹墀立，下節門外階下排立，齊鞠躬，通名畢，先再拜，鞠躬，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: Next the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led in from the left to stand on the red terrace; the lower-rank staff were arranged in ranks below the steps outside the gate; all bowed with bent body; when their names had been announced they bowed again first; bowed with bent body; without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Next the chief stewards and upper- and middle-rank staff were led in from the left to stand on the court terrace, while the lower-rank staff were arranged in ranks below the steps outside the gate. All bowed with bent body. When their names had been announced, they bowed again first and bowed with bent body. Without leaving formation they reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

translations.literal: " The herald called: "Bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The herald called: "Bow.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜，下節聲喏呼「萬歲」，如前儀。

translations.literal: " They bowed again; the lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls and called "Long live" as in the previous protocol.
translations.idiomatic: " They bowed again. The lower-rank staff gave ceremonial calls and called "Long live" as in the previous protocol.

sentences.zh: 喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: The herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」畢，平立，再鞠躬，喝：「賜酒食。

translations.literal: " When finished they stood level; bowed with bent body again; the herald called: "Wine and food are granted.
translations.idiomatic: " When finished they stood at ease, bowed with bent body again, and the herald called: "Wine and food are granted.

sentences.zh: 」聲喏再拜呼「萬歲」，如前儀。

translations.literal: " They gave ceremonial calls, bowed again, and called "Long live" as in the previous protocol.
translations.idiomatic: " They gave ceremonial calls, bowed again, and called "Long live" as in the previous protocol.

sentences.zh: 引左廊立。

translations.literal: They were led to stand in the left corridor.
translations.idiomatic: They were led to stand in the left corridor.

sentences.zh: 待床入，進酒。

translations.literal: When the couch was brought in, wine was presented.
translations.idiomatic: When the couch was brought in, wine was presented.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲酒時，上下侍立皆再拜。

translations.literal: When the emperor drank wine, all who attended above and below, standing in service, bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor drank wine, all who attended above and below, standing in service, bowed again.

sentences.zh: 俟進酒官至位，合坐官再拜，皆坐。

translations.literal: When the wine-presenting officials had reached their places, the seated officials as a group bowed again, and all sat.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine-presenting officials had reached their places, the seated officials bowed again as a group, and all sat down.

sentences.zh: 即行臣使酒，普傳宣，立飲，再拜，複坐。

translations.literal: Then the wine for ministers and envoys was served; the announcement was transmitted to all; they stood and drank; bowed again; and sat again.
translations.idiomatic: Then wine was served to the ministers and envoys. The announcement was transmitted to all. They stood, drank, bowed again, and sat down again.

sentences.zh: 次人從鞠躬聲喏再拜呼「萬歲」之儀如前。

translations.literal: Next the attendants' protocol of bowing with bent body, giving ceremonial calls, bowing again, and calling "Long live" was as before.
translations.idiomatic: Next the attendants' protocol of bowing with bent body, giving ceremonial calls, bowing again, and calling "Long live" followed as before.

sentences.zh: 皆坐。

translations.literal: All sat.
translations.idiomatic: All sat down.

sentences.zh: 至第三盞，傳宣立飲，畢，再拜，複坐。

translations.literal: At the third round, the announcement was transmitted; they stood and drank; when finished they bowed again and sat again.
translations.idiomatic: At the third round, the announcement was transmitted. They stood and drank. When finished, they bowed again and sat down again.

sentences.zh: 次人從如前，畢，坐。

translations.literal: Next the attendants followed as before; when finished they sat.
translations.idiomatic: Next the attendants followed as before. When finished, they sat down.

sentences.zh: 俟致語，聞鼓笛時，揖臣使皆立，俟口號絕，臣使再拜，坐，次人從如前儀，複坐。

translations.literal: When awaiting the formal address, at the sound of drums and flutes the ministers and envoys were prompted to rise; when the chorus ended the ministers and envoys bowed again and sat; next the attendants followed the previous protocol and sat again.
translations.idiomatic: During the formal address, at the sound of drums and flutes the ministers and envoys were prompted to rise. When the chorus ended they bowed again and sat down. Next the attendants followed the previous protocol and sat down again.

sentences.zh: 次至五盞，將曲終，人從立，再如前儀，畢，先引出。

translations.literal: Next at the fifth round, as the music was about to end, the attendants stood and again followed the previous protocol; when finished they were led out first.
translations.idiomatic: Next at the fifth round, as the music was about to end, the attendants stood and again followed the previous protocol. When finished, they were led out first.

sentences.zh: 臣使起再拜，退至丹墀，合班，謝宴，再拜，舞蹈，三拜，喝：「各祗候。

translations.literal: The ministers and envoys rose and bowed again; withdrew to the red terrace; formed a combined formation; thanked the banquet; bowed again; performed the ritual dance and three prostrations; the herald called: "Each attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers and envoys rose and bowed again, withdrew to the court terrace, and formed a combined formation. They thanked the court for the banquet, bowed again, and performed the ritual dance and three prostrations. The herald called: "Each remain in attendance.

sentences.zh: 」引出，至三門階下，與閣門副使相揖別，與客省同行，至幕次前對立，先揖，各傳示，再揖，請分位，就幕次。

translations.literal: " They were led out to below the steps of the Triple Gate; bowed in parting with the Gate Office deputy commissioner; walked together with the Guest Reception Office to the front of the tent quarters and faced one another; bowed first; each side transmitted for display; bowed again; were invited to separate places; and went to their tent quarters.
translations.idiomatic: " They were led out to below the steps of the Triple Gate, bowed in parting with the Gate Office deputy commissioner, and walked together with the Guest Reception Office to the front of the tent quarters. They faced one another, bowed, each side transmitted the message for display, bowed again, were invited to separate places, and went to their quarters.

sentences.zh: 少頃，請館伴與使副出幕次，外為上，對立，先揖，各傳示，再揖，引行，至元下馬處，請左右易位，對立揖，收笏上馬，至館，聲喏相揖分位，與初入見還禮同。

translations.literal: After a little while the hostel escort and envoy and deputy were invited out of the tent quarters; the outside was superior and they faced one another; bowed first; each side transmitted for display; bowed again; were led to proceed; reached the original dismounting place; were invited to exchange left and right positions; bowed facing one another; put away their tablets and mounted; reached the hostel; gave ceremonial calls and bowed and separated to their places; the same as the return ceremony upon first entering for the audience.
translations.idiomatic: After a little while the hostel escort and the envoy and deputy were invited out of the tent quarters, where the outside took precedence, and faced one another. They bowed, each side transmitted the message for display, bowed again, and were led on. At the original dismounting place they exchanged left and right positions, bowed facing one another, put away their tablets and mounted, and returned to the hostel. They gave ceremonial calls, bowed, and separated to their places, following the same return ceremony as upon first entering for the audience.

sentences.zh: 第六日，賜分食，並賜酒果禮。

translations.literal: On the sixth day, distributed meals were granted, along with the wine-and-fruit ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day came the grant of distributed meals and the wine-and-fruit ceremony.

sentences.zh: 天使至館，與第二日賜酒果禮同。

translations.literal: When the imperial envoy reached the hostel, it was the same as the second day's wine-and-fruit ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial envoy reached the hostel, the ceremony followed the same protocol as the second day's grant of wine and fruit.

sentences.zh: 是日，支押分食酒果軍土物，並在館隨局分官員承應人例物。

translations.literal: That day the distributed-meal and wine-and-fruit escort troops' local products were dispensed, as were the standard gifts for officials and attendants assigned to each bureau at the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: That day local products were dispensed to the escort troops for the distributed meals and wine and fruit, as well as the standard gifts for officials and attendants assigned to each bureau at the hostel.

sentences.zh: 凡裏外門將軍、監廚直長、館都監、監酒食官、承應班祗候、眾廚子、館子、巡護軍、館伴所牽攏官，皆溥及之。

translations.literal: In general the inner and outer gate generals, kitchen supervisors and section chiefs, hostel chief stewards, wine-and-food supervising officials, attendants of the service corps, all the cooks, hostel staff, patrol guards, and the leading officers attached to the hostel escort were all broadly included.
translations.idiomatic: In general the inner and outer gate generals, kitchen supervisors and section chiefs, hostel chief stewards, wine-and-food supervising officials, attendants of the service corps, all the cooks, hostel staff, patrol guards, and the leading officers attached to the hostel escort were all broadly included.

sentences.zh: 第七日，曲宴禮，如前儀。

translations.literal: On the seventh day, the separate banquet ceremony followed the previous protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day came the separate banquet ceremony, following the previous protocol.

sentences.zh: 第八日，奉辭之儀。

translations.literal: On the eighth day, the farewell ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day came the farewell ceremony.

sentences.zh: 至小起居畢，閣使先奏來使辭榜子。

translations.literal: When the minor bow of respect was finished, the Gate commissioner first presented the incoming envoy's farewell memorial.
translations.idiomatic: When the minor bow of respect was finished, the Gate commissioner first presented the incoming envoy's farewell memorial.

sentences.zh: 引使者左入，傍折通班，至丹墀再拜，不出班奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: The envoy was led in from the left, turned aside through the formation, came to the red terrace and bowed again, and without leaving formation reported: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy was led in from the left, passed through the formation, and came to the court terrace, where he bowed again and reported without leaving formation: "May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: " He bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed again.

sentences.zh: 揖副鞠躬，使出班戀闕致詞，復位，再拜，喝：「各好去。

translations.literal: The deputy was prompted to bow with bent body; the envoy left formation and delivered the parting words of lingering regard for the court, returned to place, bowed again, and the herald called: "Each of you, go in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy was prompted to bow with bent body. The envoy stepped out of formation to deliver the parting words expressing reluctance to leave the court, returned to his place, and bowed again. The herald called out: "Each of you, go in peace.

sentences.zh: 」引右出，次引宰執下殿，禮畢。

translations.literal: " He was led out on the right; next the chief ministers were led down from the hall and the ceremony was finished.
translations.idiomatic: " He was led out on the right. The chief ministers were then led down from the hall, and the ceremony was complete.

sentences.zh: 第九日，聚廳，送至恩華館，更衣而行。

translations.literal: On the ninth day they assembled in the hall, were escorted to the Enhua Lodge, changed dress, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day they assembled in the hall, were escorted to the Enhua Lodge to change dress, and departed.

sentences.zh: 凡使將至界，報至則差接伴使，至則差館伴使，去則差送伴使，皆有副，皆差書表以從。

translations.literal: In general, when an envoy was about to reach the border, upon notice of arrival a reception envoy was assigned; upon arrival a hostel escort was assigned; upon departure a farewell escort was assigned; each had a deputy, and document officers were always assigned to accompany them.
translations.idiomatic: In general, when an envoy was nearing the border, a reception envoy was assigned upon notice of arrival, a hostel escort upon arrival, and a farewell escort upon departure. Each had a deputy, and document officers were always assigned to accompany them.

sentences.zh: 凡行省來宴、回宴之押宴官，皆從行省定差，就藉以文武高爵長官之職，以為轉銜之光。

translations.literal: All banquet commissioners for arrival banquets and return banquets at branch secretariats were fixed by assignment from the branch secretariat, borrowing the offices of high civil and military ranks to lend luster to the exchange of titles.
translations.idiomatic: Banquet commissioners for arrival and return banquets at branch secretariats were assigned by the branch secretariat, borrowing the titles of high civil and military offices to lend dignity to the exchange of formal titles.

sentences.zh: 來回之賜宴天使，皆以閣門祗候往，詔書、口宣皆稟命於都省，以翰林院定撰焉。

translations.literal: Imperial envoys granting banquets on arrival and departure were all sent from the Gate Office attendants; edicts and oral announcements were all commanded by the central secretariat and drafted by the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial envoys granting banquets on arrival and departure were drawn from Gate Office attendants. Edicts and oral announcements were issued by the central secretariat and drafted by the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 夏使至，或許貿易於市二日。

translations.literal: When a Xia envoy arrived, trade in the market might be permitted for two days.
translations.idiomatic: When a Western Xia envoy arrived, trade in the market might be permitted for two days.

sentences.zh: 使至，所差者館伴使、副各一，監察、奉職、省令史各一，書表四，總領提控官、酒食官、監廚、稱肉官各一，牽攏官三十，尚食局直長、知書、都管、接手、湯藥直長、長行各一，廚子五，奉飲直長一、長行二，奉珍二，儀鸞直長一、長行十，把內外門官二，館外巡防軍三十，把館甲軍六十二，雜役軍六十，過位不通漢語軍十，凡雜役皆衣皁，過食司吏八十，街市廚子四十，方脈雜科醫各一，醫獸一，鞍馬二十四匹，後止備八匹，押馬官一員。

translations.literal: When the envoy arrived, those assigned were one hostel escort and one deputy, one surveillance commissioner, one service officer, and one secretariat clerk each, four document officers, one chief control officer, one wine-and-food officer, one kitchen supervisor, and one meat-weighing officer each, thirty leading officers, one director each from the Imperial Kitchen Bureau for documents, chief stewards, handlers, medicinal-broth directors, and long-service attendants, five cooks, one drink-serving director and two long-service attendants, two delicacy servers, one ceremonial guard director and ten long-service attendants, two gatekeepers for inner and outer gates, thirty patrol troops outside the hostel, sixty-two armored troops guarding the hostel, sixty miscellaneous service troops, ten troops at stations who did not understand Chinese, all miscellaneous laborers wearing black, eighty food-service clerks, forty market cooks, one physician each for pulse diagnosis and miscellaneous specialties, one veterinary physician, twenty-four saddle horses later reduced to eight, and one horse-escort officer.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy arrived, the court assigned one hostel escort and one deputy; one surveillance commissioner, one service officer, and one secretariat clerk; four document officers; one chief control officer, wine-and-food officer, kitchen supervisor, and meat-weighing officer; thirty leading officers; and one director each from the Imperial Kitchen Bureau for documents, chief stewards, handlers, medicinal-broth service, and long-service attendants. There were also five cooks; one drink-serving director and two attendants; two delicacy servers; one ceremonial guard director and ten attendants; two gatekeepers for the inner and outer gates; thirty patrol troops outside the hostel; sixty-two armored troops guarding the hostel; sixty miscellaneous service troops; ten troops at relay stations who did not understand Chinese, all miscellaneous laborers in black clothing; eighty food-service clerks; forty market cooks; one physician each for pulse diagnosis and miscellaneous specialties; one veterinary physician; twenty-four saddle horses, later reduced to eight; and one horse-escort officer.

sentences.zh: 又差說儀承受禮直官一員。

translations.literal: One protocol-instruction duty officer was also assigned.
translations.idiomatic: One protocol-instruction duty officer was also assigned.

sentences.zh: 凡在館鋪陳繳絡器皿什物，戶部差官與東上直閣同點檢。

translations.literal: All furnishings, bedding, vessels, and miscellaneous objects in the hostel were jointly inspected by an officer assigned from the Ministry of Revenue and a direct attendant of the Eastern Upper Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: All furnishings, bedding, vessels, and miscellaneous objects in the hostel were jointly inspected by an officer from the Ministry of Revenue and a direct attendant of the Eastern Upper Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 所經橋道皆先期命工部修治之。

translations.literal: All bridges and roads along the route were ordered repaired in advance by the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: All bridges and roads along the route were ordered repaired in advance by the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 凡賜衣，使副各三對，人從衣各二對，使副幣帛百四十段，舊又賜貂裘二，無則使者代以銀三錠，副代以帛六十匹，後削之。

translations.literal: For granted robes, the envoy and deputy each received three pairs, and attendants' robes two pairs each; the envoy and deputy received one hundred forty bolts of silk; formerly two sable fur coats were also granted, but if unavailable the envoy substituted three ingots of silver and the deputy sixty bolts of silk; this was later reduced.
translations.idiomatic: For granted robes, the envoy and deputy each received three pairs and the attendants two pairs each. The envoy and deputy received one hundred forty bolts of silk. Formerly two sable fur coats were also granted; if unavailable, the envoy substituted three ingots of silver and the deputy sixty bolts of silk, though this practice was later reduced.

sentences.zh: 惟生餼則代以綾羅三十九匹、帛六十二匹、布四匹。

translations.literal: Only for live provisions were thirty-nine bolts of gauze silk, sixty-two bolts of plain silk, and four bolts of cloth substituted.
translations.idiomatic: Only for live provisions were thirty-nine bolts of gauze silk, sixty-two bolts of plain silk, and four bolts of cloth substituted instead.

sentences.zh: 金帶三，金鍍銀束帶三，金塗銀鬧裝鞍轡三，金塗銀渾裹書匣、間金塗銀裝釘黑油詔匣及包書、詔匣複各一。

translations.literal: Three gold belts, three gold-plated silver girdles, three gold-overlaid silver decorated saddles and bridles, three gold-overlaid silver fully wrapped document cases, and one each of gold-inlaid silver-mounted black-lacquer edict cases with document wrappers and edict-case covers.
translations.idiomatic: There were three gold belts, three gold-plated silver girdles, three gold-overlaid silver decorated saddles and bridles, three gold-overlaid silver fully wrapped document cases, and one each of gold-inlaid silver-mounted black-lacquer edict cases with document wrappers and edict-case covers.

sentences.zh: 朝辭，賜人從銀二百三十五兩，絹二百三十五匹。

translations.literal: At the farewell audience, attendants were granted two hundred thirty-five taels of silver and two hundred thirty-five bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: At the farewell audience, attendants were granted two hundred thirty-five taels of silver and two hundred thirty-five bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 賜宋、高麗使之物，其數則無所考。

translations.literal: The items granted to Song and Goryeo envoys cannot be verified in number.
translations.idiomatic: The quantities of items granted to Song and Goryeo envoys cannot be verified.
